# Wuthering Waves: Combined AI Reference

Snapshot: 2026-09-20. Read the scope and data-quality sections before using numeric values.



---

## Wuthering Waves: AI Knowledge Pack

ชุดไฟล์ Markdown สำหรับให้ AI ค้นข้อมูลและอ้างอิงต่อ ครบ 5 หมวดตามโจทย์ โดยใส่รายละเอียดสกิลจริงที่ค้นได้แทน template ว่าง. วันที่รวบรวมคือ 20 กันยายน 2026; เนื้อหาความสามารถใช้ภาษาอังกฤษเพื่อรักษาชื่อสกิลและคำทางระบบ ส่วนคำแนะนำการใช้งานเป็นภาษาไทย.

### ไฟล์หลัก

| ไฟล์ | เนื้อหา |
|---|---|
| `01-echo-mainstats-substats.md` | Mainstats แยก Cost 1/3/4 และ rarity 2–5; substats 13 ชนิด; ระบบ Modifier/Transducer |
| `02-echo-set-bonuses.md` | 34 Sonata sets พร้อมเงื่อนไข จำนวนชิ้น ระยะเวลา และ stack |
| `03-echo-skills-cost-4-3-1.md` | 181 Echo: Cost 4 = 43, Cost 3 = 53, Cost 1 = 85 พร้อม skill และ main-slot passive ที่แหล่งข้อมูลระบุ |
| `04-all-weapon-abilities.md` | 122 อาวุธ: passive, trigger, R1 และ progression R1–R5 พร้อมธงข้อมูลรอง |
| `05-all-character-abilities.md` | 58 kits แยก variants พร้อม Basic/Skill/Forte/Liberation/Intro/Outro/Inherent และ S1–S6 |
| `06-data-quality-and-coverage.md` | ช่องว่าง ข้อขัดแย้ง และการตัดสินใจเรื่องแหล่งข้อมูล |
| `character-chunks/` | แบ่งตัวละครเป็น 6 ไฟล์ย่อยสำหรับ AI ที่รับไฟล์ใหญ่ไม่สะดวก |
| `data/` | JSON ที่จัดโครงสร้างแล้ว มี URL ต้นทาง เหมาะกับการค้นและแปลงไฟล์ต่อ |

จำนวนข้างต้นนับจากระเบียนที่รวบรวมในชุดไฟล์ ไม่ใช่การรับรองจำนวนคอนเทนต์ทั้งหมดในเกม ณ ทุกเซิร์ฟเวอร์. รายการอ้างอิงหลักคือ [Game8 Echo List](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452491), [Weapon List](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452490) และ [Sonata Effects](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456215); หน้ารายตัวแนบอยู่ในไฟล์แต่ละหมวด.

### อ่านก่อนใช้คำนวณ

- **ไม่ใช่ official game-data export:** ชุดนี้สรุปจากเว็บข้อมูลชุมชนและคู่มือ พร้อมลิงก์ต้นทาง ไม่ได้ดึงข้อมูลจาก client เกมหรือทดสอบทุกสกิลในเกม.
- **ขอบเขตเวอร์ชัน:** ใช้ snapshot ของหน้าที่ตรวจอ่าน ไม่รวมรายการ Echo ที่ยังเป็น TBD และไม่อ้างว่าครบคอนเทนต์ในอนาคต; หน้าอ้างอิงแสดงข้อมูลยุค 3.6 และ preview 3.7. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/559680))
- **ระดับสกิล:** ตัวเลขตัวละครส่วนใหญ่เป็น Lv.1 ตามตารางต้นทาง ไม่ใช่ Lv.10; เอฟเฟกต์คงที่และ attribute node ต้องอ่านแยกจากการเพิ่มระดับสกิล.
- **ข้อมูลขัดกัน:** Mainstats บางค่าไม่ตรงกันระหว่างเว็บ จึงเก็บทั้งสองค่า; JSON ใช้ `null` สำหรับ endpoint ที่ยังตัดสินไม่ได้. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278); [Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))
- **อาวุธที่ใช้แหล่งรอง:** R2–R5 ของ Lumingloss และ Thunderbolt ได้จาก Theria Games เพราะตาราง Game8 ไม่ครบ จึงควรตรวจในเกมก่อนคำนวณละเอียด. ([Lumingloss](https://theriagames.com/guide/wuthering-waves-lumingloss/); [Thunderbolt](https://theriagames.com/guide/wuthering-waves-thunderbolt/))

### วิธีส่งให้ AI

เริ่มจากไฟล์นี้และ `06-data-quality-and-coverage.md` แล้วแนบเฉพาะหมวดที่ต้องใช้. ถ้าต้องการให้ AI อ่านทั้งหมด ใช้ไฟล์รวมที่ส่งแยก หรือแตก ZIP แล้วอัปโหลดไฟล์ Markdown ตามความจุของระบบ; ไม่จำเป็นต้องอัปโหลดทั้งไฟล์ตัวละครรวมและ chunks ซ้ำกัน.

#### Prompt พร้อมใช้

```text
ใช้ชุด Wuthering Waves AI Knowledge Pack ที่แนบเป็นฐานความรู้
1. อ่าน README และ data-quality ก่อน แล้วค้นในหมวดที่เกี่ยวข้อง
2. รักษาชื่อสกิล ตัวเลข หน่วย trigger stack duration cooldown และผู้รับบัฟ
3. ห้ามเติมข้อมูลจากความจำโดยไม่ระบุแหล่งอ้างอิงเพิ่มเติม
4. n.a. / null = ยังไม่ทราบ ไม่ใช่ 0 และไม่ใช่ไม่มีเอฟเฟกต์
5. หากแหล่งข้อมูลขัดกัน ให้รายงานสองค่าและขอค่าจากเกม ไม่เลือกเอง
6. แยก Cost, rarity, Echo Skill rank, weapon R1–R5 และ character S1–S6
7. ห้ามอ้างตัวเลข Skill Lv.1 เป็น Lv.10 หรือประมาณค่าระดับอื่นเอง
8. แยก DMG Bonus, Amplification, DEF ignore และ RES reduction
9. แยก Echo active, main-slot passive และ Sonata set bonus
10. คง URL อ้างอิงไว้ติดกับข้อมูลใน Markdown ที่สร้างต่อ
11. ถ้าคำถามเกินขอบเขตหรือ snapshot ของไฟล์ ให้ค้นเพิ่มและแจ้งส่วนที่อัปเดต
```

### สิ่งที่ชุดนี้ไม่ได้รับรอง

ไม่ได้ให้ damage simulator, rotation ที่ทดสอบจริง, tier list หรือ multiplier ทุกระดับ 1–10 ของทุกตัวละคร. ช่องว่างรายตัวอยู่ท้ายแต่ละระเบียนและใน audit file เพื่อให้ AI ไม่เข้าใจว่าแค่มีหัวข้อครบแล้วหมายถึงข้อมูลทุกฟิลด์ได้รับการยืนยัน.

## Echo Mainstats & Substats

วันที่รวบรวม: 2026-09-20 | หน่วย: ค่าร้อยละใช้ `%`; ค่าที่ไม่มี `%` เป็น flat stat. เอกสารนี้แยก Cost, rarity และ level ออกจากกัน และเก็บค่าที่ขัดกันไว้ทั้งสองแหล่ง ไม่เฉลี่ยหรือเลือกค่าแทนโดยไม่มีหลักฐาน.

### โครงสร้างและข้อจำกัด

- **Mainstats:** มีสองบรรทัด ได้แก่ primary mainstat ที่สุ่มตาม cost และ secondary mainstat แบบ fixed; Cost 1 มี fixed HP ส่วน Cost 3/4 มี fixed ATK. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278))
- **Cost กับ rarity:** Common = 1, Elite = 3, Overlord/Calamity = 4; rarity แยกต่างหากตั้งแต่ 2 ถึง 5. ([Wuthering Waves Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))
- **Cost budget:** สูงสุด 12 เมื่อ Data Bank Level 9; ผลรวม cost ของ Echo ที่สวมต้องไม่เกินเพดาน. ([Wuthering Waves Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))
- **Substats:** มีได้สูงสุด 5 บรรทัด ไม่ซ้ำชนิดกันใน Echo ชิ้นเดียว แต่ชนิด substat สามารถตรงกับ mainstat ได้. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278); [Wuthering Waves Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))

การคำนวณ loadout: `4+3+3+1+1 = 12` และ `4+4+1+1+1 = 11`. สองรูปแบบนี้จึงไม่ใช้ cost เท่ากัน และไม่มีข้อบังคับในชุดข้อมูลนี้ว่าต้องใช้ budget จนเต็ม.

| Rarity | Level สูงสุด | จำนวน substats สูงสุด |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2★ | 10 | 0 ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278)) |
| 3★ | 15 | 3 ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278)) |
| 4★ | 20 | 4 ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278)) |
| 5★ | 25 | 5 ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278)) |

### Mainstats: ทุก rarity แยกตาม cost

### Substats ทั้ง 13 ชนิด

การปรับรูปแบบข้อมูล: แก้เฉพาะสัญลักษณ์ `%` ซ้ำของ ER 8.4 และเติมหน่วย `%` ให้ CR 10.5 ตามชื่อคอลัมน์ โดยไม่ได้เปลี่ยนค่าตัวเลข. ช่วง roll ยังตรวจเทียบกับ [Echo Tuning Guide](https://wutheringwaves.party/en/guides/echo-tuning-guide/) ส่วนคำอธิบายเก่าใน Wiki ที่ว่า reroll ไม่ได้นั้นไม่ใช้เป็นกฎปัจจุบัน. ([Wuthering Waves Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats); [Transducer](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/578127))

### Modifier และ Transducer

- **Modifier:** ใช้เปลี่ยน mainstat ของ Echo 5★; แท็บ Data Modify ปรากฏที่ Union Level 40 ตามคู่มือ. อย่าสับสนกับการ reroll substats. ([Game8: Modifier](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/519077))
- **Transducer:** ใช้ reroll substat ที่ไม่ได้ล็อกของ Echo 5★ ที่ tune ครบแล้ว; เลือกเก็บผลเดิมหรือผลใหม่ได้ แต่เลือกผลเดิมแล้วไม่ได้คืน Transducer. ([Game8: Transducer](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/578127))
- **ค่าใช้จ่าย Transducer:** ล็อกไม่เกิน 2 บรรทัดใช้ 1 ชิ้น; ล็อก 3 บรรทัดใช้ 2 ชิ้น; ล็อก 4 บรรทัดใช้ 3 ชิ้น. ([Game8: Transducer](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/578127))

### กฎสำหรับ AI

- ใช้ `null` / `n.a.` เป็น unknown ไม่ใช่ศูนย์.
- ห้ามเลือกค่าในแถว `[ขัดกัน]` อัตโนมัติ; ขอค่าจากหน้าจอเกมหรือแสดงผลหลายสมมติฐาน.
- ห้ามถือว่า mainstat, substat, Echo Skill, main-slot passive และ Sonata bonus เป็นเอฟเฟกต์เดียวกัน.
- ตารางเป็นค่าที่อ่านจากแหล่งข้อมูล ณ วันที่รวบรวม ไม่ใช่การรับรองจากไฟล์เกมหรือการทดสอบภายในเกม.

## Echo Set Bonuses / Sonata Effects

วันที่รวบรวม: 2026-09-20. รวม 34 ชื่อที่มีข้อความเอฟเฟกต์ในฐานข้อมูลที่ตรวจอ่าน ไม่ใช้ template แทนรายละเอียด และไม่สมมติว่าทุกเซ็ตต้องเป็น 2/5 ชิ้น. ([Game8: Sonata Effects](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456215))

### วิธีอ่าน

`pieces` คือจำนวนชิ้นที่ต้องมีเพื่อเปิดเอฟเฟกต์นั้น. เงื่อนไข trigger, ระยะเวลา, stack, ผู้รับบัฟ และเงื่อนไขจบเอฟเฟกต์คงแยกเป็น bullet เพื่อให้ AI ประมวลผลต่อได้.

## Echo Skills: Cost 4 / 3 / 1

วันที่รวบรวม: 2026-09-20. ขอบเขตที่เก็บได้: 181 รายการ แบ่งเป็น Cost 4 จำนวน 43, Cost 3 จำนวน 53 และ Cost 1 จำนวน 85; ไม่นับแถว skill/code TBD ของรายการล่วงหน้า. ([Game8: Echo List](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452491))

### วิธีอ่านและขอบเขต

`Sonata options` คือชื่อเซ็ตที่รายการนั้นอาจอยู่ ไม่ได้หมายความว่า Echo ชิ้นเดียวให้ทุกเซ็ตพร้อมกัน. ตัวเลขสกิลอ้างตาม rarity/rank ที่หน้ารายตัวระบุ โดยแยกข้อความหลักกับหลักฐานเสริมเพื่อไม่ผสมค่าคนละระดับ. ([Wuthering Waves Wiki: Echo Stats](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))

เมื่อมี `Supplementary evidence` ให้ใช้เป็นข้อมูลเสริมเฉพาะค่าที่ระบุ พร้อมตรวจ `rarity_basis`. ข้อจำกัดในบล็อกหลักอาจได้รับคำตอบในบล็อกเสริมแล้ว; ไม่ตีความคำว่าแหล่งหลักไม่ระบุว่าเอฟเฟกต์นั้นไม่มีอยู่.

## All Weapon Abilities: Researched Inventory

วันที่รวบรวม: 2026-09-20. รวม 122 อาวุธในชุดข้อมูลนี้ พร้อม passive และลำดับค่า R1 → R5 ที่อ่านได้; ไม่ใช่เฉพาะชื่อหรือ template. รายการหลักมาจาก [Game8 Weapon List](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452490) และหน้ารายตัวซึ่งแนบกับทุกระเบียน.

### กฎการอ่าน

ค่า base ATK / secondary stat เป็น Lv.90 เฉพาะแถวที่แหล่งข้อมูลให้ไว้. `R1` ถึง `R5` คือ refinement/syntonization ของอาวุธ ไม่ใช่ระดับอาวุธหรือ Resonance Chain ของตัวละคร.

`DMG Bonus`, `DMG Amplification`, `DEF ignore` และ `RES reduction` คงชื่อแยกตามต้นทาง ห้ามรวมเป็นตัวคูณเดียวโดยอัตโนมัติ. หากไม่มีเงื่อนไขในหลักฐาน จะระบุว่า source ไม่ให้ข้อมูล ไม่ใช้การคาดเดาว่าไม่มีข้อจำกัด.

- The effect specifies no resource cost, stacks, cooldown, party-wide application, next-character effect, off-field condition, or DEF/RES ignore. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/498528))

## All Character Abilities: Researched Inventory

วันที่รวบรวม: 2026-09-20. รวม 58 ชุดความสามารถ โดยนับ Rover แต่ละธาตุและตัวละคร variant แยกกัน ไม่ใช่ 58 บุคคลที่ไม่ซ้ำ; ทุกระเบียนมี URL ของหน้า kit ที่ใช้จริง.

### ขอบเขตตัวเลขและการใช้กับ AI

ข้อความ mechanics เป็นสรุปเชิงข้อมูล ไม่ใช่คำแนะนำจัดทีม. ตาราง `quantitative_details` ส่วนใหญ่เป็น Skill Lv.1 ตามหัวตารางต้นทาง; ห้ามนำไปอ้างเป็น Lv.10 หรือใช้ level-scaling extrapolation โดยไม่มีตารางเพิ่ม.

บัฟคงที่, Inherent Skill และ attribute-bonus node ไม่จำเป็นต้องเพิ่มตาม skill level แม้ระบบสกัดแนบคำว่า Lv.1 มาตามส่วนของหน้าต้นทาง. ตัวเลขที่ผิดรูปแบบจะคงข้อความดิบเพื่อ audit แต่ค่าที่ใช้คำนวณต้องเป็น `n.a.` จนกว่าจะยืนยันใหม่.

ทุกตัวมี Resonance Chain S1–S6 ในไฟล์นี้. ชื่อ category ของ Basic/Normal Attack, Intro/Outro, Liberation และ Forte อาจต่างกันเล็กน้อยตามหน้าอ้างอิง แต่รักษา trigger, resource, stack, duration และ restrictions เท่าที่แหล่งข้อมูลระบุ.

#### Normal Attack: Half Truths

- Basic Attack fires up to 5 consecutive shots that deal Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
- Basic Attack 4 spreads Mist forward; the Mist lasts 1.5s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))

- Mist Shot consumes Stamina to fire consecutive mid-air shots at a target, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Trickster's Opening Show**
  - Reduces Resonance Skill cooldown by 4s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
- **S2: Mistweaver's Debut**
  - Mist Avatar inherits 100% more HP from Aalto. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
  - Aalto's ATK increases by 15% when attacking targets taunted by the Mist Avatar. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
- **S3: Hazey Transition**
  - When Aalto's Basic Attack or Mid-Air Attack passes through the Gate of Quandary, 2 additional bullets are generated. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
  - Each additional bullet deals 50% of the damage of the relevant Basic Attack or Mid-Air Attack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
- **S4: Blake Bloom for Finale**
  - Increases Resonance Skill Vaporized Bullet damage by 30%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
  - Reduces damage received by Aalto in the Mist Stealth state by 30%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
- **S5: Applause of the Lost**
  - Increases Aalto's Aero DMG Bonus by 25% for 6s while he is in the Forte Circuit Mistcloak state. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
- **S6: Broker's Secrets**
  - Flower in the Mist additionally increases Crit. Rate by 8%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))
  - When Aalto's Heavy Attack passes through the Gate of Quandary, damage dealt is additionally increased by 50%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454214))

### Aemeath

#### Normal Attack: Infinity Calibration

#### Forte Circuit: To Sculpt the Silence

- Seraphic Duo: Casting Aemeath or Mech Basic Attack Stage 4 enters Seraphic Duo for 5 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Seraphic Duet: Overture: While in Aemeath form, Seraphic Duo is active, and Synchronization Rate is at least 100, Resonance Skill consumes 100 Synchronization Rate to deal Fusion DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. It can be cast mid-air, switches to Mech, exits Seraphic Duo, and permits a timely Normal Attack to cast Mech Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Seraphic Duet: Encore: While in Mech form under the same conditions, Resonance Skill consumes 100 Synchronization Rate to deal Fusion DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. It can be cast mid-air, switches to Aemeath, exits Seraphic Duo, and permits a shortly-following Normal Attack to cast Aemeath Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Resonance Mode:Tune Rupture: When the team triggers Tune Rupture:Interfered, inflict 10 Rupturous Trail stacks on the target for 30 seconds, up to 30 stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Resonance Mode:Fusion Burst: When the team inflicts Fusion Burst, inflict 1 Fusion Trail stack for 30 seconds, up to 30 stacks. When nearby targets' Fusion Burst reaches 0 stacks during combat, inflict 1 Fusion Burst stack. If a target has more than 5 Fusion Burst stacks, trigger Fusion Burst using its maximum stack limit and remove all stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- In either Resonance Mode, the listed Aemeath and Mech Basic Attack Stages 3-4, Sync Strike skills, and the listed Intro Skills can inflict the mode's corresponding response on damage, once per skill per target every 3 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- In Tune Rupture mode, Seraphic Duet removes Rupturous Trail from nearby targets and adds five Tune Rupture DMG instances, each against a random target in range. Each removed Rupturous Trail stack increases Seraphic Duet's additional-instance DMG Multiplier against that target by 4% for 1 second. Off-Tune Level does not affect these instances. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- In Fusion Burst mode, Seraphic Duet removes Fusion Trail from affected targets and triggers Fusion Burst at the target's maximum stack limit without removing its stacks. Each removed Fusion Trail stack increases main-target Fusion Burst DMG Multiplier by 10%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- During Stardust Resonance, Tune Rupture mode Seraphic Duet additionally deals 10 Tune Rupture DMG instances. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- During Stardust Resonance, Fusion Burst triggered on the main target by Seraphic Duet gains an additional 200% DMG Multiplier; this stacks with the Fusion Trail increase. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Tune Rupture Response:Starburst: In Tune Rupture mode, deal Fusion DMG to targets affected by Tune Rupture:Interfered; this is considered Tune Rupture DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Starflux Thrust: In Mech form with more than 200 Starflux, use the Utility button to launch into the air while continuously consuming Starflux. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Synchronization Rate is capped at 200. Aemeath/Mech Basic Attacks, Mid-air Attacks, Dodge Counters, and both Sync Strikes recover it. Songs Across the Universe and Debut of Meteoric Radiance recover 40; Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 30; while Instant Response and Heavenfall Edict: Unbound are both active, either Charged II recovers 200. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Resonance Rate is capped at 4. Seraphic Duet and Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive each recover 1; Overdrive additionally recovers 1 during Starlume Acceleration. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- Starflux is capped at 600 and recovers naturally over time. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn**
  - Instant Response Heavy Attacks gain 300% Crit. - **S2: Downy Notes of Snowfluff**

- **S3: Fervor Sightly Burns Bright as New**
  - Finale DMG Multiplier +100%, Overdrive DMG Multiplier +40%; Instant Response Heavy Attacks inflict the mode response; Between the Stars is replaced by the 60% Crit. DMG version with 25% Finale Amplification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))

- **S5: Voyage to the Astral Shore**
  - Skill defeats reset Starflux to 100%; fatal damage creates a 5-second 2D Digital Ghost that shields allies and then revives Aemeath with the stated recovery, once per 10 minutes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/572587))
- **S6: A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You**

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Complex Simplicity**

- **S2: Silent Tundra**

- **S3: Veritas Lux Mea**
  - Overflowing Frost increases Baizhi’s Max HP by 12% for 10 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- **S4: Eternal Verity**
  - After casting Momentary Union, Remnant Entities can be performed 2 additional times. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
  - Remnant Entities’ healing multiplier increases by 20%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))

- **S5: A Wish Answered**
  - If a team member is downed while Baizhi is alive in the team, that member is immediately revived and restored to 100% HP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
  - This effect can trigger once every 10 minutes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- **S6: Seeker’s Devotion**
  - When Euphonia is picked up, all nearby characters gain 12% Glacio DMG Bonus for 20 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))

#### Evidence limitations

- The evidence does not explicitly identify whether every listed HP or Health scaling value uses current HP or Max HP; values are retained using the source wording. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- The Emergency Plan Forte Circuit table labels are ambiguous: “Heavy Attack with ‘Concentration’ Con. Energy Regen: 4,” “Resonance Skill with ‘Concentration’ Con.: 8,” and “Heavy Attack ‘Concentration’ Con.: 2.5” do not clearly state whether each is per consumed Concentration or a total. The mechanics text confirms that Heavy Attack restores Resonance and Concerto Energy, while Emergency Plan restores Concerto Energy. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- The source does not provide separate numerical tables for the inherent skills, Outro Skill, Tune Break, Euphonia, or most additional effects. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- The source states that Remnant Entities automatically consume stacks every 2.5 seconds but does not explicitly state a duration or whether the entities disappear when stacks reach zero. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- The source does not specify the exact target range for “nearby” beyond using that term. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))
- The source does not specify whether the team-wide healing wording includes Baizhi in every instance, although it states “entire team” or “all team members nearby.” ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454224))


### Brant

- Element: Fusion; weapon: Sword; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))

#### Normal Attack: Captain's Rhapsody

- Basic Attack: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- Heavy Attack: Consumes Stamina to attack the target and deal Fusion DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- Heavy Attack – Rhapsodic Riff: After Basic Attack Stage 2 or Stage 4, hold Normal Attack to perform this attack. It can also be performed by pressing Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 4. It consumes Stamina and deals Fusion DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- Mid-air Attack: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG, and consumes Stamina. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- After Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2, press Normal Attack to swing toward the target with Grapple. Brant attacks the target if he reaches it. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- During the Grapple swing, releasing the input after the attack hits makes Brant flip backward. Holding Normal Attack makes him attack continuously, then flip backward after the finishing move. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- Brant automatically flips backward after Mid-air Attack Stage 3. Pressing Normal Attack after each flip performs the next Mid-air Attack stage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- Each flip resets Brant's available mid-air Dodge Attempts. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing from Mid-air Attack Stage 1, he instead performs a forward slash. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing from Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or 2 but the attack does not hit, he temporarily suspends in mid-air and then falls. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))
- Dodge Counter: Press Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge to attack the target and deal Fusion DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486245))

- Heavy Attack – Thunder Over Mountain: Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram – Thunder and Trigram – Mountain, in that order. Deals a small amount of Electro DMG and additionally reduces the target’s Vibration Strength. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Heavy Attack – Twin Mountains: Hold Normal Attack to consume two highlighted Trigrams – Mountain from left to right. Heals all nearby Resonators in the team. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Heavy Attack – Twin Thunders: Hold Normal Attack to consume two highlighted Trigrams – Thunder from left to right. Heals all nearby Resonators in the team once per second for 8s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Heavy Attack – Ghost Gate Omen: If Normal Attack is held while Buling has fewer than 2 Trigrams, the divination fails. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina to perform an attack that deals Electro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Dodge Counter: Press Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge to perform Basic Attack Stage 3 and deal Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack after the Dodge Counter to perform Basic Attack Stage 4. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Trigram system: Buling can hold up to 4 Trigrams. When at maximum capacity, obtaining a new Trigram shifts all existing Trigrams one slot to the left and removes the original leftmost Trigram. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Trigram – Mountain is gained when Basic Attack Stage 2 deals damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))
- Trigram – Thunder is gained when Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack deals damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/557981))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Covert Negotiation**

- **S2: Zero-Sum Game**
  - After Calcharo casts Intro Skill Wanted Criminal or Intro Skill Necessary Means, his Resonance Skill DMG Bonus increases by 30% for 15s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- **S3: Iron Fist Diplomacy**
  - During Deathblade Gear, Calcharo's Electro DMG Bonus increases by 25%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- **S4: Dark Alliance**
  - After Shadowy Raid is cast, the Electro DMG Bonus of all team members increases by 20% for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- **S5: Unconventional Compact**
  - Intro Skill Wanted Criminal and Intro Skill Necessary Means deal 50% more damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- **S6: The Ultimatum**
  - When Calcharo casts Resonance Liberation:Death Messenger, he summons 2 Phantoms for coordinated attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
  - Each Phantom deals Electro DMG equal to 100% of Calcharo's ATK. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
  - The Phantom damage is classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))

#### Evidence limitations

- The evidence does not provide an explicit time limit for recasting Extermination Order before its switch-out/recast condition causes cooldown. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- The Forte Circuit table contains two separate Con. Energy Regen entries for Mercy and Death Messenger; the source does not identify whether the second pair represents a different energy type, so both rows are retained verbatim. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- The source's named Intro Skill is Wanted Outlaw, but S2 and S5 call the corresponding skill Wanted Criminal; the evidence does not resolve whether this is a naming inconsistency or a separate skill. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- The source does not provide a separate numerical multiplier for the increased Deathblade Gear Dodge Counter damage beyond the listed Heavy Attack/Dodge Counter table rows. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))
- The source does not specify the exact target-selection behavior or duration of the Shadowy Raid Phantom beyond attacking targets in front and supporting the on-field Resonator. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454217))

#### Forte Circuit: Vegetative Universe

- Normal Attack, Vining Waltz, Blazing Waltz, Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter:Atonement, Crimson Blossom, and Floral Ravage consume Crimson Pistils when hitting a target and increase the attack's Energy Regen Multiplier. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Camellya can hold up to 100 Crimson Pistils. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Consuming 10 Crimson Pistils restores 4 Concerto Energy and grants one Crimson Bud. Crimson Buds last 15 seconds and stack up to 10 times. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- When Concerto Energy is full and Ephemeral is not on cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced by Ephemeral. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Ephemeral consumes 70 Concerto Energy, deals Havoc DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG, and can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- After Ephemeral, Camellya enters Budding Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Budding Mode grants Sweet Dream, increasing the DMG Multiplier of Normal Attack, Vining Waltz, Blazing Waltz, Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter:Atonement, Crimson Blossom, and Floral Ravage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Ephemeral consumes all Crimson Buds; each consumed Bud increases Sweet Dream's DMG Multiplier by 5%, up to 50%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Camellya cannot gain Crimson Buds during Budding Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- During Budding Mode, the Energy Regen Multiplier of the listed attacks is reduced to 0%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Budding Mode ends when Camellya leaves the field or when all Crimson Pistils are consumed. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Intro Skill Everblooming restores 100 Crimson Pistils. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- Activating Ephemeral restores 100 Crimson Pistils. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- The evidence identifies an Ephemeral-related Forte effect but does not provide a separate base Sweet Dream numerical value. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))

  - Resonance Skill Ephemeral's DMG Multiplier is increased by 120%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- **S3: A Bud Adorned by Thorns**
  - Resonance Liberation Fervor Efflorescent's DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
  - Camellya's ATK is increased by 58% during Budding Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- **S4: Roots Set Deep in Eternity**
  - Casting Everblooming grants all team members 25% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 30 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- **S5: Infinity Held in Your Palm**
  - The DMG Multiplier of Everblooming is increased by 303%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
  - The DMG Multiplier of Twining is increased by 68%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
- **S6: Bloom For You Thousand Times Over**
  - Sweet Dream's DMG Multiplier is additionally increased by 150%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
  - Adds the Forte Circuit skill Perennial: within 15 seconds after Ephemeral, when Concerto Energy is full and Perennial is available, Resonance Skill becomes Perennial. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))
  - Perennial costs 50 Concerto Energy, restores 50 Crimson Pistils, deals Havoc DMG equal to 100% of Ephemeral DMG, counts as Basic Attack DMG, and has a 25-second cooldown. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))

  - Camellya cannot be interrupted while casting Perennial. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/473332))

#### Forte Circuit: Between Illusion and Reality

- Mirage changes Basic Attack into Basic Attack: Phantom Sting. Phantom Sting performs up to 3 consecutive Havoc attacks and can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Mid-air Phantom Sting consumes Stamina, and its combo does not reset while Cantarella is airborne. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Hitting a target with Phantom Sting consumes 1 Trance, grants 1 Shiver, and heals all nearby team Resonators. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- The third Phantom Sting stage triggers 3 Coordinated Attacks that deal Havoc DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Mirage changes Mid-air Attack into Abysmal Vortex. Jump performs its plunging attack and consumes Stamina. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Mirage changes Dodge Counter into Dodge Counter: Shadowy Sweep. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- When Abysmal Vortex or Shadowy Sweep hits a target, it consumes 1 Trance, grants 1 Shiver, and heals all nearby team Resonators. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Mirage lasts 8 seconds and ends when Trance is depleted. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- When Cantarella has 3 Shiver while in Mirage, Resonance Skill becomes Perception Drain. It consumes all Shiver, attacks the target, deals Havoc DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG, applies Hazy Dream, heals all team Resonators, and is also considered an Echo Skill when cast. It can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- After Intro Skill, Cantarella enters Abyssal Rebirth for 25 seconds. During this state, when team Resonators cast Echo Skills, Cantarella recovers 6 Concerto Energy, up to 6 times. Echoes with the same name can trigger this recovery only once. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- While in water, Cantarella's swimming speed increases and Stamina cost decreases. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Trance has a maximum of 5 points. Intro Skill restores 1 Trance; Basic Attack Stage 3 restores 1; Graceful Step restores 1; Flowing Suffocation restores 3; while in water, Cantarella restores 1 Trance every 5 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- Shiver has a maximum of 3 points. Phantom Sting restores 1 Shiver on hit; Abysmal Vortex and Shadowy Sweep each restore 1 Shiver when they hit a target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))
- The Forte Circuit attribute nodes provide ATK bonuses. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/500493))

#### Normal Attack: Silent Execution

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Crown Destined by Fate**
  - When Cartethyia or Fleurdelys directly damages and defeats a target affected by Aero Erosion, gains Zeal for 10s. While Zeal is active, after defeating enemies, the next attack that directly damages a target raises its Aero Erosion stacks to the highest count among defeated targets, without exceeding the current maximum stack limit. Zeal is then removed and enters a 1s cooldown. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - When Fleurdelys Conviction reaches 30, 60, 90, or 120, Cartethyia and Fleurdelys gain 25% Crit DMG per threshold, up to 4 stacks, for 15s. The duration does not reset when gaining more stacks. Blade of Howling Squall removes this Crit DMG increase. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- **S2: Blade Broken by Tempest**
  - Casting A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers increases the maximum Aero Erosion stack limit for targets in range by 3. The next attack that directly damages those targets inflicts 3 Aero Erosion stacks on all targets in range and immediately triggers Aero Erosion DMG once without consuming stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - Increases Cartethyia Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, and Intro Skill damage multipliers by 50%, and Mid-air Attack damage multiplier by 200%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - After Cartethyia Mid-air Attack, each recalled Sword Shadow type reduces Cartethyia's Resonance Skill cooldown by 1s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- **S3: Prisoner Hanged in The Tower**
  - Fleurdelys Basic Attack Stage 5, Mid-air Attack Stage 5, Enhanced Heavy Attack, and May Tempest Break the Tides each inflict 2 Aero Erosion stacks on hit. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - Increases Blade of Howling Squall's damage multiplier by 100%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- **S4: Sacrifice Made for Salvation**
  - When a team Resonator inflicts Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Spectro Frazzle, Electro Flare, Glacio Chafe, or Aero Erosion, all team Resonators gain 20% DMG Bonus for all Attributes for 20s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- **S5: Hope Reshaped in Storms**
  - When Cartethyia or Fleurdelys would take a fatal hit, prevents that instance from downing her and grants a shield equal to 20% of Cartethyia's maximum HP for 10s. Can trigger once every 10 minutes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - Reduces the HP cost of A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers to 25% of maximum HP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- **S6: Freedom Found in Storm's Wake**
  - After Blade of Howling Squall, raises the hit target's Aero Erosion stacks to maximum. Blade of Howling Squall no longer removes those stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - For 30s after Sword to Mark Tide's Trace, Sword to Call for Freedom, A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers, or Blade of Howling Squall, when any team Resonator inflicts Aero Erosion on a target at maximum stacks, immediately triggers Aero Erosion DMG once. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
  - Targets take 40% more damage from Fleurdelys. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))

#### Evidence limitations

- The evidence does not provide a numerical Conviction gain per Fleurdelys hit or a stated Conviction cap beyond the 120-point activation threshold. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- The duration or timing window for casting May Tempest Break the Tides before the skill enters cooldown is not numerically specified. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- The source describes the Forte as Mid-air Attack Stage 2 in the Liberation text but the Forte skill table lists only Mid-air Attack Stages 1–3; the exact mapping of all transformed mid-air stages is ambiguous. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- The inherent-skill wording says targets with more than 3 Aero Erosion stacks receive an additional 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks; the exact interpretation of the total stack-based multiplier is not further clarified. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- No numerical values are supplied for the Stagnate duration, interruption-resistance increase, force-field ranges, pull strength, water-walking Stamina drain, or Aero Erosion damage itself. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- The source labels the Tune Break trigger but supplies no damage, duration, cooldown, or other effect details. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))
- The source supplies attribute-bonus rows but does not explicitly assign them to individual upgrade nodes beyond the listed skill sections. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507777))

### Chisa

- Element: Havoc; weapon: Broadblade; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))

#### Normal Attack: Reign of Silence

- Basic Attack performs up to 2 consecutive Havoc attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Press Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 2 to cast Rending Lunge. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Rending Lunge deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after it on the ground to cast Death Snip. Use or hold Normal Attack shortly after it in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Death Snip opens the scissors for Havoc DMG, then snips after a delay for additional Havoc DMG and heals all nearby team Resonators. Normal Attack during Death Snip deals additional Havoc DMG; press Normal Attack again to snip immediately. Death Snip DMG is Resonance Liberation DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Thread Withdrawn deals Havoc DMG and enables successful Dodges within a certain time after casting. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Heavy Attack launches Chisa into the air, consumes Stamina, and deals Havoc DMG. It cannot be cast in Chainsaw Mode. Within a certain time afterward, press Normal Attack, or cast Lifethread - Glide and press Normal Attack before landing, to cast Hanging Finality. Hold Normal Attack before landing to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina for a plunging Havoc attack. Outside Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Heavy Attack - Severed Facet deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Hanging Finality. If interrupted, hold Normal Attack before landing to recast it once before landing. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Hanging Finality consumes Stamina for a plunging Havoc attack. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting it on the ground to cast Death Snip. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Dodge Counter is cast by pressing Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge and deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Rending Lunge. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- After a successful ground Dodge, hold Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction, which Stagnates the target and deals Havoc DMG. Outside Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air after casting it to cast Rending Lunge; this follow-up is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode. In Chainsaw Mode, press Normal Attack to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Normal Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet, Hanging Finality, and Dodge Counter variants are Havoc damage unless otherwise specified. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))

#### Resonance Skill: Fractured Composition

- Eye of Unraveling Stagnates the target and deals Havoc DMG. Outside Chainsaw Mode, pressing Normal Attack on the ground or using Normal Attack in mid-air after casting it casts Rending Lunge; this follow-up is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode. In Chainsaw Mode on the ground, pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Sawring - Blitz Stage 2. Eye of Unraveling can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- When Ring of Chainsaw is full while Chisa is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced by Serrated Loop. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Serrated Loop Stagnates targets, deals Havoc DMG, and pulls nearby targets inward. Casting it enters Chainsaw Mode and replaces Resonance Skill with Eye of Unraveling. Press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Hold Resonance Skill during Serrated Loop to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Releasing the button during the duration, or continuing to hold it for a certain period, casts Sawring - Blitz Stage 1. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))

#### Forte Circuit: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion

- Unseen Snare marks a target for 30s. Chisa applies it by hitting a target with Resonance Skill, hitting a target within a certain period after Serrated Loop, hitting a target with Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction, or locking on to a target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- When a marked target takes direct damage from a Resonator, Chisa applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane, at most once every 2s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Thread of Bane causes Chisa to ignore 18% of the DEF of targets affected by Unseen Snare. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Chainsaw Mode unlocks Sawring - Blitz, Sawring Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter. Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consume Ring of Chainsaw on hit. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Sawring - Blitz can chain up to 3 attacks and deals Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack to begin at Stage 1; hold it to begin at Stage 2. Holding Normal Attack during Stage 2 sustains the attack, and Stage 2 automatically proceeds to Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- During Stage 2, releasing Normal Attack or Dodging without directional input automatically casts Stage 2: Discordance. Successful Dodges can be triggered shortly after Discordance; press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- During Stage 3, holding Normal Attack sustains the attack and it automatically proceeds to Sawring - Eradication. Releasing Normal Attack casts Stage 3: Falltone. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Sawring - Blitz DMG and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter DMG are Resonance Liberation DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter is cast with Normal Attack after a successful Dodge in Chainsaw Mode. Press Normal Attack afterward, or hold it until the attack ends, to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3. Releasing Normal Attack or Dodging without directional input casts Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance. This counter deals Resonance Liberation DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Sawring - Eradication is cast after Stage 3: Falltone or after Sawring - Blitz/Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consumes all Ring of Chainsaw. It deals Havoc DMG and grants shields to all nearby team Resonators for 30s. Its DMG is Resonance Liberation DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Each point of Ring of Chainsaw consumed by Sawring - Blitz or Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter increases the next Sawring - Eradication DMG multiplier; up to 100 points count. Casting Sawring - Eradication consumes all Ring of Chainsaw and ends Chainsaw Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Chainsaw Fever starts at 100% in Chainsaw Mode. It rapidly depletes when Chisa does not deal damage. At 0, Chisa enters Burnout State and exits Chainsaw Mode. Damage, Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Reverberance - Return, and Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone reset Chainsaw Fever in Chainsaw Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- In Burnout State, Ring of Chainsaw rapidly depletes. At 0, Chisa leaves Burnout State. Dealing damage or casting Moment of Nihility or Reverberance - Return also ends Burnout State. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524880))
- Outside Chainsaw Mode, with more than 10 Lifethread - Jetstream, Chisa can consume 50 to cast Lifethread - Glide after specified aerial actions: Heavy Attack, Eye of Unraveling, Rending Lunge, Thread Withdrawn, or another Lifethread - Glide. ### Ciaccona

- Element: Aero; weapon: Pistols; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))

#### Normal Attack: Quadruple Time Steps

- Performs up to four consecutive attacks that deal Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))
- Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target hit. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))
- If one of the first three Basic Attack stages is interrupted by dodging, pressing Basic Attack at the proper timing resumes the attack cycle with the corresponding stage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona begins Solo Concert. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))
- If Basic Attack Stage 4 or Solo Concert ends early, either proactively or through interruption, an Ensemble Sylph is generated. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))
- Heavy Attack consumes Stamina to jump into the air and attack, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/507924))

#### Forte Circuit: “Flawless”

- After Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, generates an Erosion Field for 30s. Only one Erosion Field created by Denia can exist at a time. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Erosion Field pulls nearby targets in once every 4s and deals Fusion DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Void Particle can reach 100 points. In Breakdown Form, Normal Attack hits consume Void Particle; the attack is classified as Resonance Liberation DMG, its damage multiplier increases by 50%, and Conformal Charge regenerates 100% faster. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst: listed qualifying skills inflict 2 Fusion Burst stacks per damage instance, with each skill limited to once every 2s against the same target. Qualifying skills are Intro Skill - It's Been A While!, Intro Skill - Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, and Erosion Field. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- In Fusion Burst mode, the listed Stage 3 and Stage 4 attacks inflict Fusion Burst once per qualifying skill activation, subject to the same 2-second per-target restriction: Stagecraft Form Basic Attack Stages 3 and 4; Breakdown Form Basic Attack Stages 3 and 4; and Breakdown Form Mid-air Attack Stages 3 and 4. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- While Denia is in the team, an enemy defeated by Fusion Burst DMG counts as defeated by the nearest active Resonator. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Resonance Mode - Tune Strain: qualifying skills inflict Tune Strain - Shifting and reset the target's Tune Strain - Interfered duration; each skill can trigger this only once every 2s against the same target. Qualifying skills are both Intro Skills, both Final Act forms, Erosion Field, and Stagecraft/Breakdown Basic and Mid-air Attack Stages 3 and 4. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- When a team Resonator inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, the target's Off-Tune Level increases by 50% of its maximum. This can occur on the same target once every 300s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Dark Core capacity is 3. During Entropy Shift, Denia obtains 1 Dark Core every 12s. She also gains 1 Dark Core when casting either Intro Skill. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Void Particle capacity is 100. While in Stagecraft Form, Normal Attack damage grants Void Particle. Either Intro Skill or Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form grants 25 Void Particle. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))
- Conformal Charge capacity is 100. While in Breakdown Form, Normal Attack damage and Beckon - Breakdown Form damage grant Conformal Charge. Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 grants 40 Conformal Charge. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/585681))

- While in Demon Hypostasis, each Afterflame point increases the DMG of Seraphic Execution, Flamewing Verdict, Hellsent Barrage, Ravage, and Purgatory Scourge by 1.5%, up to 60%. Afterflame is removed when Demon Hypostasis ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Demon Hypostasis ends when Purging Flame is depleted or after more than 50 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Basic Attack : Seraphic Execution: Perform up to 5 Fusion attacks. Stages 1–3 are Heavy Attack DMG; Stages 4–5 are Echo Skill DMG. Consume Purging Flame on hit. After Stage 5, pressing Normal Attack performs Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Heavy Attack : Flamewing Verdict: Consume STA for up to 3 consecutive Fusion attacks; consume Purging Flame on hit. Stage 3 is Echo Skill DMG. After Stage 1, Normal Attack performs Seraphic Execution Stage 2; after Stages 2–3, it performs Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Mid-air Attack : Hellsent Barrage: While airborne, press Normal Attack to consume STA for Fusion aerial attacks classified as Heavy Attack DMG; hold it to fire continuously. Both consume Purging Flame on hit. Releasing the button performs a Plunging Attack, followed by Seraphic Execution Stage 3 when Normal Attack is pressed. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- If Galbrena is interrupted during Hellsent Barrage without landing, she cannot immediately recast it. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Dodge Counter : Purgatory Scourge: After a successful Dodge, press Normal Attack for Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG. Press Normal Attack afterward to perform Seraphic Execution Stage 4. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Resonance Skill : Ravage: Dash forward and leap; flip backward after hitting the target, dealing Fusion DMG classified as Heavy Attack DMG and consuming Purging Flame on hit. Ravage and Encroach share a cooldown. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Hellstride: While casting Galbrena's own skills on the ground, press Dodge to deal fixed Fusion DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG. It receives no DMG buffs, can trigger successful Dodges, cannot be cast consecutively, and does not reset attack cycles when cast within a short time. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Burning Drive: Casting Intro Skill, Hellstride, Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4, Encroach, Ascent of Malice, or Ravage grants 20% interruption resistance and 20% ATK for 4 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Afterflame: Maximum 40 points. In Threshold State, an allied Resonator's Echo Skill restores 8 points. Echoes with the same name can trigger this recovery only once; the effect resets when Galbrena exits Demon Hypostasis. All Afterflame is removed on exit. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))
- Sinflame: Maximum 100 points. In Threshold State, hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Volley of Death, Ashfall Barrage, Encroach, or Intro Skill : Hellflare Overload restores Sinflame. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524888))

- Foreclaimed Self: After entering this state, Present Self Basic Attack is replaced by up to 5 consecutive attacks. These attacks deal Glacio DMG and count as Resonance Liberation DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))

- When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Foreclaimed Self Heavy Attack becomes Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self. - Foreclaimed Self Dodge Counter replaces Present Self Dodge Counter, deals Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG, and can chain into Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack Stage 3 shortly after casting. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))

#### Forte Circuit: Everfrost Dominion

- Glacio Bite conversion: While Hiyuki is in the team, nearby team Resonators' Glacio Chafe is converted to Glacio Bite. Each new Glacio Bite stack triggers one Glacio Bite DMG instance based on the target's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can affect frozen targets, counts as Glacio Chafe, and its damage counts as Glacio Chafe DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target with at least 10 Glacio Bite stacks, 10 stacks are consumed and Frostbind is triggered once. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- When Hiyuki joins the team, all target Glacio Chafe stacks are removed. When she leaves, all Glacio Bite stacks are cleared unless another team Resonator can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Present Self: Hiyuki starts in this state. Certain skills restore Dedication. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Foreclaimed Self: Entered after Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. This form restores Frostheart through specified attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Iai Stance requires at least 100 Frostheart. After eligible Foreclaimed Self Normal Attacks, Jade Cleave, Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge, pressing Dodge can make Hiyuki flash backward, consume Stamina, and enter Iai Stance. Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed, Jade Cleave, Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, and Frostedge are excluded from the relevant Dodge trigger. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Within the specified window after Jade Cleave or Petalfall, holding Resonance Skill can also enter Iai Stance. With a valid target in range and forward input held, Hiyuki flashes behind the enemy instead. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance in mid-air. Entering it resets mid-air Dodge charges. Switching out ends Iai Stance. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Basic Attack - Iai is available shortly after entering Iai Stance. It consumes 100 Frostheart and deals Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Liberation DMG. If at least 100 Frostheart remains, another Basic Attack - Iai can be cast during the follow-up window. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- If Hiyuki is hit during Basic Attack - Iai, she negates that damage instance, becomes interruption-resistant afterward, and reduces incoming DMG by 100%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Each Basic Attack - Iai consumes 1 Frostharden Iai if available, applies 3 Glacio Chafe stacks, and grants 1 Whiteout Bitterfrost. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Dedication has a maximum of 300. In Present Self, Present Self Basic Attack Stage 3 restores 100 Dedication; Intro Skill - Frostedge restores 200. The Resonance Skill enhancement adds another 100 Dedication restoration to the next Present Self Basic Attack Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Frostheart has a maximum of 300. It is restored by Jade Cleave, Petalfall, and Foreclaimed Self Normal Attacks other than Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3. Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Whiteout Bitterfrost has a maximum of 3. Each Frostharden Iai consumed by Basic Attack - Iai grants 1 stack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Snowforged Blade has a maximum of 3. Each Foreclaimed Self Heavy Attack grants 1 stack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- Glacio Chafe applied by Hiyuki or nearby Resonators is subject to the Glacio Bite conversion while she is present. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Springless**
  - The DMG multipliers of Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Plunging Attack, and Dodge Counter increase by 120%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack Stage 3 gains increased range and pulls enemies toward its center. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - Hiyuki is interruption-resistant during Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack Stages 4 and 5. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision enhances the next Foreclaimed Self Basic Attack Stages 1 and 2; those attacks apply 1 Glacio Chafe on hit. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- **S2: To Burn Cold in Silence**
  - Basic Attack - Iai's DMG multiplier increases by 125%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - Ephemeral Realm changes: after leaving combat or recovering from being knocked out and staying out of combat for 4 seconds, restore 3 Snowforged Blade instead of 1. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - The same trigger restores 3 Frostharden Iai while in Foreclaimed Self, resets the cooldown of 2 Jade Cleave charges, and grants an additional 50 Frostheart to the next 2 Jade Cleave or Petalfall casts. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- **S3: No Self, No Bound**
  - Fine Snow gains an effect that grants Hiyuki 1 Snow Rust 2 seconds after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived; this method can grant at most 1 stack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - The DMG multipliers of Frost Splinter: Present Self and Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self increase by 160%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - At 2 Snow Rust, the additional Glacio Bite DMG triggered each time Hiyuki applies Glacio Chafe has its DMG multiplier increased by 488%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- **S4: Like Reeds on Tides**
  - Casting Resonance Skill: Present Self, Jade Cleave, or Petalfall increases all nearby team Resonators' damage by 20% for 30 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - Casting Jade Cleave or Petalfall restores 18% of Hiyuki's maximum HP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- **S5: Vessel of Thousand Wishes**
  - The DMG multipliers of Resonance Skill: Present Self, Jade Cleave, and Petalfall increase by 80%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
- **S6: Into a Night Without End**
  - The Crit. DMG of Foreclaiming: Inward Vision and Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation increases by 500%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - At 2 Snow Rust, the Fine Snow effect changes so that every team Resonator's Glacio Chafe application, rather than only Hiyuki's, additionally triggers the fixed-multiplier Glacio Bite DMG instance. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - At 2 Snow Rust, Hiyuki gains another 40% Crit. DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))
  - At 3 Snow Rust, targets within the specified range of the active team Resonator take 25% more total Glacio Bite DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/586421))

#### Forte Circuit: Ebb and Flow

- Lunar Cycle is activated by Closing Refrain or Resonance Liberation. It lasts 15 seconds, begins in Half Moon by default, and can switch between Half Moon and New Moon through Heavy Attack - Flux. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- While in Lunar Cycle, Jump is replaced by Heavy Attack - Flux, Stamina does not recover while Iuno is airborne, and movement becomes Meandering. Meandering continuously consumes Stamina while airborne. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- Environmental interactions, Utilities, or holding Jump ends Lunar Cycle. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- In Half Moon, Iuno attacks with Moonring and restores Sentience when attacks hit. Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow deals Aero DMG, counts as Resonance Liberation DMG, and changes the state to New Moon. It can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- In New Moon, Iuno attacks with Moonbow. Moonbow Basic Attacks, Moonbow Dodge Counter, and Arc Beyond the Edge consume Sentience to increase their damage multipliers, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby team Resonators. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))

- When Concerto Energy is full, Heavy Attack becomes Absolute Fullness. #### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Wax or Wane, All Gild the Bough**
  - While in Lunar Cycle, ATK increases by 40%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
  - Inside Full Moon Domain, restore 1 Resonance Energy per second. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
  - Arc Beyond the Edge and Absolute Fullness become interruption-immune. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- **S2: Day or Night, Let This Be Eternal**
  - Team Resonators with 10 Blessing of the Wan Light stacks gain 40% additional all-DMG Amplification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- **S3: I Drink Deep of Their Forgetting**
  - While in Lunar Cycle, Moonbow Basic Attack, Arc Beyond the Edge, and Moonbow Dodge Counter gain 65% damage amplification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
  - For an unspecified period after Moonbow Basic Attack or Moonbow Dodge Counter, Arc Beyond the Edge does not reset the Moonbow Basic Attack cycle. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- **S4: Rainy Season Dwell in My Eyes**
  - Absolute Fullness grants all team Resonators a Shield equal to 160% of Iuno's ATK for 30 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
  - The Shield cannot be transferred to an incoming Resonator. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- **S5: A Thousand Futile Glimpses**
  - Gain 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
- **S6: I Am the Constant in the Chaos**
  - Absolute Fullness's DMG Multiplier increases by 1600%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))
  - Casting it re-enters Lunar Cycle - New Moon, grants 100 Sentience, and resets all Arc Beyond the Edge cooldowns. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524889))

#### Forte Circuit: Primordial Chi Spiral

- When Chi reaches its maximum, holding Heavy Attack casts Primordial Chi Spiral and begins Zhoutian Progress. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- During Zhoutian Progress, Jianxin has increased anti-interruption and takes 50% less damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- During Zhoutian Progress, Jianxin continuously consumes Chi and repeatedly uses Chi Strike against nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Zhoutian Progress advances through stages that grant different shields and attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Before Minor Zhoutian: Jianxin gains a Zhoutian Progress 1 shield. If progress is interrupted, she uses Pushing Punch against the target, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Minor Zhoutian: Jianxin gains a Zhoutian Progress 2 shield and uses Shock against the target, dealing Aero DMG. If progress is interrupted, she uses Yielding Pull against the target, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Major Zhoutian:Inner: Jianxin gains a Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and uses Shock against the target, dealing Aero DMG. If progress is interrupted, she uses Yielding Pull against the target, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Major Zhoutian:Outer: Jianxin gains a Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and uses Shock against the target, dealing Aero DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Releasing the Basic Attack button interrupts Zhoutian Progress and consumes all remaining Chi. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Zhoutian Progress also ends when all Chi is consumed. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- When Zhoutian Progress ends, Jianxin gains a shield based on the highest Zhoutian Progress reached. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- While the shield from Primordial Chi Spiral remains active, it restores HP to the on-field character once every 6s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Chi has a maximum capacity of 120. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- Chi is gained when Fengyiquan Normal Attacks hit a target, Calming Air is cast, Chi Counter or Chi Parry hits a target, or Intro Skill Essence of Tao hits a target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))
- The source does not provide numerical Chi gain or consumption values. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454213))

- After Shadow Step, pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Drink Soul Stage 2 in Yin Vessel or Devil's Bane Stage 2 in Yang Font. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605307))

#### Forte Circuit: Luminal Synthesis

- Jinhsi can hold up to 50 Incandescence. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- While in Incarnation, Incarnation - Basic Attack replaces Basic Attack. It performs up to 4 consecutive strikes, deals Spectro DMG treated as Resonance Skill DMG, does not reset its Basic Attack cycle, and can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- While in Incarnation, Crescent Divinity replaces Resonance Skill, deals Spectro DMG, and can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- While in Incarnation, Incarnation - Heavy Attack becomes available. It attacks the target in mid-air, consumes Stamina, and deals Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- While in Incarnation, Incarnation - Dodge Counter becomes available, deals Spectro DMG, and can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- After Incarnation - Basic Attack Stage 4, Incarnation ends and Jinhsi gains Ordination Glow. Ordination Glow lasts 5s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- While Ordination Glow lasts, Basic Attack is replaced by Incarnation - Heavy Attack, which attacks the target in mid-air, consumes Stamina, and deals Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- While Ordination Glow lasts, Resonance Skill is replaced by Illuminous Epiphany. It sends out a Solar Flare that detonates Stella Glamor after a short delay and deals Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- Illuminous Epiphany consumes up to 50 Incandescence. Each consumed Incandescence point grants a bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to Stella Glamor. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- Illuminous Epiphany can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- After casting Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi gains Unison. This can trigger once every 25s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- Unison lasts 5s. While Jinhsi has Unison, switching to another Resonator removes Unison and triggers Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- When Concerto Energy is full, Unison is consumed before Concerto Energy when switching out. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- When Jinhsi is in the party, nearby party Resonators gain Eras in Unity. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- Through Eras in Unity, Jinhsi gains 1 Incandescence whenever a party Resonator inflicts Attribute DMG. Damage of the same Attribute can trigger this once every 3s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))
- Through Eras in Unity, Jinhsi gains 2 Incandescence whenever a party Resonator damages an enemy with Coordinated Attacks. Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute can trigger this once every 3s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455405))

#### Forte Circuit: Unification of Spirits

- Lion's Spirit is Lingyang's Forte resource and has a maximum of 100. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))

- After Glorious Plunge, Lingyang enters the Striding Lion state. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))

- While in Striding Lion, attacks can be launched in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))
- While on the ground in Striding Lion, Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge returns Lingyang to the air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))
- Lion's Spirit is continuously consumed during Striding Lion. The state ends 5 seconds after Lion's Spirit runs out. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))

- While in Striding Lion, Basic Attack is replaced by Feral Gyrate, which performs up to 2 consecutive attacks and deals Glacio DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))
- While in Striding Lion, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mountain Roamer, which deals Glacio DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))
- When Lion's Spirit is below 10, Basic Attack performs Stormy Kicks, which deals Glacio DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454223))

#### Normal Attack: Snapshot

- Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks that deal Glacio DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))

- Releasing Normal Attack within Perfect Focus performs Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring 50 Trace. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))

- Holding Normal Attack performs Basic Attack Stages 1, 2, and 3 in sequence and deploys Focus Ring during Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina to perform a plunging attack that deals Glacio DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- Dodge Counter: pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge attacks the target for Glacio DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Basic Attack Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))

- Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence consumes Stamina to plunge for Glacio DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward performs Tracing Forms Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))

- Déjà Vu: When Clear As Day is cast in Glacio Chafe mode, gain 4 Film Roll stacks for 30 seconds; Film Roll can stack up to 4 times in this state and all stacks are removed when the duration ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Distant Noon**
  - While deploying Focus Ring with Phantom Frame, the first cursor landing within Perfect Focus immediately expands Perfect Focus to fill the ring. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - Casting Spotlight increases Lucilla's Crit. Rate by 20% for 10 seconds. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - Lucilla is interruption-immune while casting Phantom Frame and Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- **S2: Slumbering Moonlight**
  - While casting Clear As Day, in Glacio Chafe mode, Glacio Chafe DMG against targets around the active Resonator is amplified by 80%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - In Echo mode, Resonators in the team gain 40% Echo Skill DMG Amplification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - These enhancements last while Reminiscence is active and remain effective for 30 seconds after Reminiscence ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - The effects end when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- **S3: Days Fade Unheard**
  - Increases Letting It Go's DMG multiplier by 100%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- **S4: The Past Fades Into Silence**
  - Oblivion pulls nearby targets in when it hits. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - While casting Oblivion, Lucilla gains 10% ATK for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 times; all stacks are removed when the duration ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - Lucilla takes 30% less damage while casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- **S5: Time is Like a Stream**
  - Increases Oblivion's DMG multiplier by 50%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
- **S6: Gazing In the Mist of Time**
  - While in Reminiscence, each Photo consumed grants 1 Remembrance stack, up to 3 stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - Each Remembrance stack increases Letting It Go's damage dealt to the target by 200%, up to 600%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - Casting Letting It Go removes all Remembrance stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
  - If Lucilla defeats a target while in Reminiscence, she gains Longing. When Reminiscence ends while she is out of combat, Longing is consumed to restore 150 Trace. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568207))
