### Lucy

- Element: Spectro; weapon: Pistol; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Normal Attack: Locked Thread

- Basic Attack: Performs up to 4 consecutive Spectro DMG attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Holding Normal Attack after Basic Attack Stage 1 performs a continuous attack. Holding Normal Attack for a certain time casts Heavy Attack Stage 1. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Holding Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands casts Heavy Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Heavy Attack: Consumes Stamina to lash enemies with Monowire for Spectro DMG. Holding Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 casts Heavy Attack Stage 2; pressing Normal Attack shortly after Heavy Attack Stage 1 instead casts Basic Attack Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina for a plunging Spectro attack. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Dodge Counter: Pressing Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge deals Spectro DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack Stage 4; holding Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Heavy Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While in Algorithm Compaction, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack - Thread Shredding: up to 4 consecutive attacks, considered Heavy Attack DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While in Algorithm Compaction, Heavy Attack becomes Heavy Attack - Single Threading: consumes Stamina to attack for Spectro DMG. While airborne, pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction; while grounded, it casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While in Algorithm Compaction and at 100 Root Access, Heavy Attack - Single Threading becomes Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. This consumes Stamina and all Root Access for Spectro DMG. Pressing or holding Normal Attack shortly afterward while airborne casts Heavy Attack - Multi-threading; while grounded, it casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Heavy Attack - Multi-threading consumes Stamina, deals Spectro DMG, and inflicts Hack - Shifting. SQL can increase its DMG Multiplier by 270%. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack becomes Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction: consumes Stamina for a plunging Spectro attack, then pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter becomes Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction: press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to deal Spectro DMG, then press Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Heavy Attack - Dual Threading and Heavy Attack - Multi-threading each restore 8 Concerto energy. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Resonance Skill: Protocol Breach

- Payload: Charges forward for Spectro DMG and inflicts Hack - Shifting. On hit, automatically performs a follow-up attack for Spectro DMG and activates Pulse Interference. If the charge hits no target, its cooldown is reduced by 70%; interruption or an unsuccessful cast does not reduce it. Pressing Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up casts Basic Attack Stage 2; holding it casts Heavy Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Pulse Interference: Cuts through the target for Spectro DMG, briefly Stagnates it, and grants Digital Handshake. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Digital Handshake: If Lucy is active and not in Algorithm Compaction, she gains TCP every second. The effect ends when TCP reaches 100 or when either listed Resonance Liberation is cast. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Deadlock: When TCP reaches 100 or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Payload and Pulse Interference are replaced by Deadlock. Deadlock deals Spectro DMG, inflicts Hack - Shifting, and is considered Heavy Attack DMG. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Casting Netrunner or Old Net Deep Dive resets Deadlock's cooldown. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Forte Circuit: Depths of Blackwall

- TCP: Maximum 100 points. Gained when Lucy deals damage with Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter, Payload, or Pulse Interference. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- After Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, the next Pulse Interference grants 20 additional TCP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Root Access: Maximum 100 points. Gained from Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Cloud Portal: Outside Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP when hitting a target. At 100 TCP, Payload and Pulse Interference become Deadlock. Netrunner or Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Algorithm Compaction: Casting Deadlock enters this state and grants 1 SQL stack. Basic Attack and Heavy Attack become Thread Shredding and Single Threading. Lucy gains 65% Spectro DMG Bonus for 8s. Recasting Deadlock during the state does not grant another SQL or repeatedly grant the Spectro bonus. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While in Algorithm Compaction, attacks including Thread Shredding and Single Threading that hit targets grant Root Access. At 100 Root Access, Single Threading becomes Dual Threading. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- If SQL is available when Multi-threading is cast, its DMG Multiplier is increased by 270% and SQL is removed. Without SQL, Multi-threading consumes 20% of current HP; no HP is consumed if Lucy's HP is below 1%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- After Multi-threading, Netrunner becomes Old Net Deep Dive. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Lucy exits Algorithm Compaction after either Liberation, or if Multi-threading is not followed by Locked Thread, Protocol Breach, Outdated Hallucination, or Tune Break - Data Crash. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Hack Response - Data Crash: Against a target affected by Hack - Interfered, Lucy deals Spectro DMG and applies Data Crash, classified as Hack DMG. After that target deals damage, it is Stagnated for 0.5s; Data Crash is then removed. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

Quantitative details (source level labels retained):

- Hack Response - Data Crash DMG: 550.37%+34.40%\*4 Tune AMP (skill Lv.1) ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Inherent Skill 1: Ghost Cyberware

- When Lucy is active and has taken no damage for 8s, she gains 1 Optical Illusion stack; default maximum is 1. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Optical Illusion reduces the next incoming damage instance by 100%. If the hit damages or launches Lucy, she immediately recovers and performs a successful ground Dodge. The stack is consumed after triggering. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- This effect can trigger at most once every 0.5s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Inherent Skill 2: Function Cracking

- When Payload, Pulse Interference, or Deadlock damages an Overlord- or Calamity-class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark for 2 minutes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While Botnet Mark is active, when a team Resonator defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains Network Backdoor. If Rebecca is in the team, Rebecca gains it too. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Network Backdoor grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier for 2 minutes, stacking up to 2 times; gaining it again refreshes duration. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- At 2 stacks, All DMG Amplification and Hack DMG Multiplier each gain an additional 5%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- If Lucy is downed, she cannot gain Network Backdoor, and existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Resonance Liberation: Netrunner / Old Net Deep Dive

- Netrunner opens Protocol Interface for 10s and starts with 24 RAM. Up to 7 distinct Spoofing Programs can be selected, each consuming RAM. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While the interface is active, Lucy marks targets in view. Selected programs affect marked targets. The view can be adjusted to mark more targets; no program can be applied if no target is in view. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- When the duration ends or Normal Attack is held, Override deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets and closes the interface; Override is Heavy Attack DMG. If RAM is exhausted or insufficient for any program, pressing Normal Attack triggers Override on all marked targets. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Can be cast airborne near the ground. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Ping costs 2 RAM, extends the field of view, and automatically marks and deals Spectro DMG to nearby targets in range; Heavy Attack DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Cyberwave Malfunction costs 4 RAM and makes marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Breach Protocol costs 4 RAM and reduces marked targets' DEF by 5% for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Synapse Burnout costs 5 RAM and deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets in range; Heavy Attack DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Cripple Movement costs 6 RAM, deals Hack DMG to all marked targets, and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Weapon Glitch costs 5 RAM and gives marked targets' attacks a chance to be reduced by 100% for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Cyberpsychosis costs 6 RAM, converts marked targets to neutral units, and reduces their Vibration Strength; it only works on Common-class enemies. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- After Multi-threading during Algorithm Compaction, Netrunner becomes Old Net Deep Dive. Old Net Deep Dive has all Netrunner effects but greatly increases Override's DMG Multiplier. After it is cast or Lucy leaves Algorithm Compaction, it becomes Netrunner again. It can also be cast airborne near the ground. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Intro Skill: Outdated Hallucination

- Deals Spectro DMG and grants all team Resonators Involuntary Sharing for 25s, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- The effect is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

- After casting, if Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction, pressing Normal Attack within the timing window casts Basic Attack Stage 2; if she is in Algorithm Compaction, it casts Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Outro Skill: Countermeasure Program

- The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until switching out. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- All team Resonators receive Countermeasure Program for 25s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While active, when a non-Lucy active Resonator inflicts Hack - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- While active, when a non-Lucy team Resonator is attacked, Lucy grants that Resonator 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates the attacker for 1s. This can trigger only once during Countermeasure Program. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Obtaining Countermeasure Program again resets its effective duration/charge. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- When the All DMG Amplification effect is active, switching to another Resonator ends Countermeasure Program early. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Tune Break: Data Crash

- When a target's Off-Tune Level is full, Lucy can cast Tune Break on it. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- When a team Resonator triggers Tune Break and causes Hack - Interfered, Lucy responds with Hack Response - Data Crash. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- Each target can be damaged by this skill at most once every 8s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream**
  - Lucy becomes interruption-immune during Payload, Pulse Interference, Dual Threading, and Multi-threading. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
  - Casting Outdated Hallucination increases ATK by 20% for 14s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
  - When a team Resonator directly defeats a target affected by a Spoofing Program, Lucy records its effect and activates the corresponding Quick Action on that Resonator for 6s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
  - Quick Action applies the recorded Spoofing Program effect to nearby targets around the active team Resonator, once per target. Recordable effects are Cyberware/Cyberwave Malfunction, Breach Protocol, Cripple Movement, Weapon Glitch, and Cyberpsychosis. Quick Action applies only their continuous status effects. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- **S2: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape**
  - Starting RAM for Netrunner and Old Net Deep Dive increases to 32. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
  - After Pulse Interference, deals one additional Heavy Attack Spectro DMG instance equal to 450% of Lucy's ATK. On hit, applies Cyberware/Cyberwave Malfunction, Breach Protocol, Cripple Movement, Weapon Glitch, and Psychosis/Cyberpsychosis; only continuous status effects are applied. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
  - When SQL is consumed by Multi-threading, its DMG Multiplier increase becomes 560% instead of 270%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598702))
- **S3: Cyberpunk**

- **S5: Embrace the Thunderous Triumph**

- **S6: To the Brightest Flaming Star**
  - Damage from Dance With the Wolf: Climax, Fire-Kissed Glory, and Intro Skill - Nowhere to Run! ignores 30% of the target's DEF. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/520661))

#### Evidence limitations

- The exact duration of the Shewolf's Hunt-to-Feral Fang availability window is not provided. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/520661))

- The source presents attribute bonuses within skill sections, but does not clearly identify their unlock conditions or whether the listed percentages are part of the corresponding skill's damage table. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/520661))
- Tune Break has no damage or effect values in the fetched evidence. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/520661))

#### Forte Circuit: Spark from the Frost

- Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker: after Aureole of Execution: Glare throws Solid-State Ichor, press Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Gavel of Earthshaker. Slam down to detonate the Ichor Deposit, deal Spectro DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG, and recover all Stamina. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- Gavel of Earthshaker is unavailable after Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is cast or Luuk Herssen leaves the field. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- With full Ichor Flow, enter Aureate Judge. Ichor Flow no longer restores in this state, all Aureole of Execution forms gain 110% DMG Multiplier, and casting Glare increases the next Gavel of Earthshaker and Ichor Deposit DMG Multipliers by 110%. Each Aureole of Execution cast consumes 100 Ichor Flow. Aureate Judge ends when Ichor Flow is depleted. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- Golden Rule: while Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other team Resonators gain Golden Rule. When a Golden Rule Resonator casts an Outro Skill and Luuk Herssen is the incoming Resonator, remove all Golden Rules from the team, grant Luuk Herssen 200 Ichor Flow and 12 Concerto Energy, and allow the team to regain Golden Rule after 24s. This effect does not function in Co-op Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- Dawnlit Keep: gain 1 stack after staying out of combat for more than 4s or casting Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn. It is capped at 1 stack. When hit by an enemy, consume 1 stack to reduce DMG taken by 60% and grant interruption immunity for 1s. This can trigger once per second. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- Radiant Reave: while airborne, Dodge briefly keeps Luuk Herssen airborne and throws an Ichor Blade. It continuously consumes Stamina. If launched airborne, Dodge before landing can trigger this effect up to 3 times. The trigger count resets when grounded or switched out for more than 3s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- Ichor Blade deals fixed Spectro DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG and is unaffected by DMG Bonuses. Only one can exist at once; it cannot trigger Counterattack and cannot launch without a nearby target. It disappears when Luuk Herssen casts another damaging skill or leaves the field. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))
- Ichor Flow has a maximum of 300 points. Normal Attacks, Golden Reflux, Aureole of Execution, Golden Impale and Gavel of Earthshaker restore it on hit. Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn restores 100 points. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568210))

### Lynae

- Element: Spectro; weapon: Pistol; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))

#### Normal Attack: Chroma Drift

- Press or hold Normal Attack for up to 3 consecutive Spectro attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Mid-air Attack consumes Stamina and deals Spectro damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Dodge Counter is performed by pressing Normal Attack immediately after a successful Dodge and deals Spectro damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- With full Overflow during Optical Sampling Stage, hold Normal Attack to charge Spark Collision. Lynae is interruption-resistant and takes 50% less damage while charging. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- During the charge, every 0.2s, 15 Overflow is converted into 12.5% Lumiflow. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Release Normal Attack, or fill Lumiflow, to cast Spark Collision. Its level depends on Lumiflow: Level 1 below 50%, Level 2 from 50% to below 100%, and Level 3 at 100%. Casting Spark Collision removes all Overflow. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Normal Attack is replaced by Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, with up to 5 consecutive Spectro attacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- With 120 Lumiflow, Kaleidoscopic Parade Basic Attack Stages 1 and 4 can track enemies from a greater distance. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, holding Normal Attack on the ground performs Ground Heavy Attack. It consumes Stamina for repeated attacks, considered Basic Attack damage; release casts Graffiti Blast, also considered Basic Attack damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, holding Normal Attack in mid-air performs Mid-air Heavy Attack, consuming Stamina and dealing Spectro damage; it is considered Basic Attack damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Mid-air Heavy Attack cannot gain new charges while airborne. Its available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and on the ground. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Mid-air Attack is replaced by Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack, which consumes Stamina for a plunging Spectro attack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Dodge Counter is replaced by Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter. Press Normal Attack shortly after it to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))

#### Forte Circuit: Chromaticity Modeling

- Optical Sampling Stage is Lynae's default state. Certain actions restore Overflow in this state. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision enters Kaleidoscopic Parade. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- During Kaleidoscopic Parade, Lumiflow continuously recovers while Lynae moves on the ground or during specified skill windows. Walking is disabled; Running and Sprinting become the faster Free Skating and Speed Skating. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap replaces Jump when Lumiflow is at least one-third of its maximum. It consumes one-third of maximum Lumiflow, deals Spectro damage, and inflicts Photochromic Flux. Successful Dodges can be triggered during the skill. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Polychrome Leap has up to 3 airborne stages; switching Resonators resets the combo. Each stage used in combat restores 1 True Color. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- After Polychrome Leap Stage 1, pressing Normal Attack on the ground within the timing window casts Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2. Stage 2 also pulls nearby targets. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- With 3 True Color while airborne, and while Visual Impact is on cooldown, pressing Normal Attack or Resonance Skill casts Iridescent Splash. It deals Spectro damage, inflicts Photochromic Flux, consumes 3 True Color, and allows Basic Attack Stage 2 if Normal Attack is pressed during its timing. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- With 3 True Color while airborne, and Visual Impact available, pressing Normal Attack or Resonance Skill casts Visual Impact. It deals Spectro damage, inflicts Photochromic Flux, consumes 3 True Color, grants nearby team Resonators 40 Tune Break Boost for 30s, and allows Basic Attack Stage 2 if Normal Attack is pressed during its timing. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- When Visual Impact is cast, it leaves Spray Paint on the ground through Inherent Skill 1. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Photochromic Flux from Polychrome Leap, Iridescent Splash, Visual Impact, and the Intro Skill activates the currently selected Resonance Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Lynae can switch between Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture and Resonance Mode - Tune Strain. Tune Rupture mode applies Tune Rupture - Shifting for 25s; Tune Strain mode applies Tune Strain - Shifting for 25s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Overflow maximum is 120. In Optical Sampling Stage, it recovers through Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter, or Intro Skill. Full Overflow enables Spark Collision. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Lumiflow maximum is 120. #### Evidence limitations

- The fetched evidence does not provide a separate numerical table for every individual sub-action or for the exact Overflow recovery amounts from normal attacks, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter, and Intro Skill; only the explicitly tabulated values are reported. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- Several timing windows are described as 'within a certain time' without a numeric duration. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source states that Basic Attack - Visual Impact grants 40 Tune Break Boost for 30s, but does not provide a separate skill-detail table row for this effect. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source's Tune Strain wording is ambiguous about whether the 0.12% increase is applied per stack, per Tune Break Boost point, or both; it is preserved as written. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source lists an Intro Skill named Time to Show Some Colors!, while Inherent Skill 2 refers to Taste My Colors!; the evidence does not clarify whether these are alternate names or a source inconsistency. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source does not provide cooldown or energy values for the Intro, Outro, or Tune Break abilities beyond the explicitly listed values. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source does not provide a separate exact damage table for the 100% Spectro damage of Let's Hit the Road!. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source does not state the scaling stat for the listed damage values; Tune Rupture Response is explicitly expressed as Tune AMP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))
- The source contains no separate weapon, acquisition, or voice-actor details beyond the stated Pistol weapon and 5-star Spectro classification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568211))

#### Forte Circuit: Mass-Energy Equivalence

- Baseline Mode: Mornye gains Rest Mass Energy while in her default mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Rest Mass Energy: Holds up to 100. It is gained in Baseline Mode from Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, or Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution hitting a target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift: At 100 Rest Mass Energy, Heavy Attack is replaced by this attack. It deals Fusion DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG, then launches Mornye into mid-air, consumes all Rest Mass Energy, and enters Wide Field Observation Mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Wide Field Observation Mode: Lasts 30s and generates a Syntony Field on entry. Mornye gains Relative Momentum. If Relative Momentum is below 100 while Normal Attack is held, she performs Wide Field Observation Mode Basic Attack Stages 1-3 in sequence; if Relative Momentum reaches 100 during this sequence, Heavy Attack - Inversion is cast instead. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- While in Wide Field Observation Mode, movement continuously consumes Stamina and Stamina cannot recover. Directional Dodging makes Mornye fly at speed for up to 10s, until Stamina is depleted, or until the mode ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- When hit or launched into mid-air, pressing Dodge immediately recovers from the attack and counts as a successful Dodge. This can trigger up to 3 times and resets when Wide Field Observation Mode ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Pressing Jump makes Mornye descend slowly. Before landing, Wide Field Observation Mode Basic Attack, Distributed Array, and Heavy Attack - Inversion are unavailable. If Jump is pressed after Stamina runs out, Wide Field Observation Mode ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Wide Field Observation Mode also ends when Mornye Dodges, Jumps, performs a mid-air attack, performs an environmental interaction, uses a Utility, switches Resonators, or is no longer airborne. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Syntony Field lasts 25s. On creation it deals Fusion DMG treated as Resonance Liberation DMG. It continuously heals nearby team Resonators inside it once every 3s, increases their Off-Tune Buildup Rate by 50%, and increases their resistance to interruption. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Heavy Attack - Inversion: At 100 Relative Momentum, Heavy Attack is replaced by this attack. It consumes all Relative Momentum, deals Fusion DMG treated as Heavy Attack DMG, can be performed mid-air, and applies Observation Marker for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/568193))
- Relative Momentum: Holds up to 100. #### Forte Circuit: Radiant Invocation

- When Prayer is full, consuming all Prayer casts one of two skills. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486244))
- Holding Basic Attack casts Heavy Attack: Absolution Litany, dealing Spectro DMG, applying 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle to targets hit, and entering Absolution status. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486244))

- Maestro grants 120% ATK, makes Phrolova float, and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate shares Phrolova's stats and statuses, and its damage is treated as Phrolova's damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Hecate's attacks do not remove targets' Hazy Dream state. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- During Maestro, Phrolova plays Volatile Notes in order; each note remains for 4s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Damage taken by Hecate while Phrolova is active also affects Phrolova. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Active-field controls: Normal Attack commands Hecate to use Basic Attack - Hecate; after every 2 Hecate Basic Attacks, the next one becomes Enhanced Attack - Hecate. Dodge commands Hecate to dodge, and a successful dodge prevents damage from that hit. Jump resets Hecate's position. Resonance Liberation commands Curtain Call - Hecate and ends Maestro. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- When Phrolova is not active, Hecate cannot take damage and automatically uses Basic Attack - Hecate. When a team Resonator casts an Echo Skill, Hecate uses Enhanced Attack - Hecate; this can trigger up to 10 times during one Maestro state, and an Echo of the same name can trigger it once. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Switching back to Phrolova ends Maestro. Ending Maestro removes all Volatile Notes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Basic Attack - Hecate performs up to 2 attacks and deals Havoc DMG classified as Echo Skill DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings is used when playing Volatile Note - Strings; it deals Havoc DMG, Stagnates targets, and is Echo Skill DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds is used when playing Volatile Note - Winds; it deals Havoc DMG, pulls targets, and is Echo Skill DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza is used when playing Volatile Note - Cadenza; it deals Havoc DMG, Stagnates and pulls targets, and is Echo Skill DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))
- Curtain Call - Hecate Stagnates targets and deals Havoc DMG. It can be cast when active Phrolova ends Maestro; when Phrolova is in Maestro and switches to Phrolova without using Intro; when Maestro ends while Phrolova is inactive and she switches in without using Intro; by pressing Resonance Liberation during Maestro; or by holding Resonance Liberation during Resolving Chord. - When Curtain Call is cast during Resolving Chord, it removes all Volatile Notes and ends Resolving Chord. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524877))

- **S1: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart**

  - Billows Beneath Heaven Crit. DMG +100%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
  - Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants World in Chorus stacks equal to the highest nearby Mindlock count. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
  - Each stack increases Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence's damage multiplier by 3%; stacks are removed after that attack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))

- **S5: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow**

  - Flight Qi cost while moving in Sword Flight -30%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))

  - Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants Exorcising Seal stacks equal to the highest nearby Mindlock count. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))

#### Evidence limitations

- The evidence does not provide exact damage values for many effects beyond the listed Skill Detail tables, nor exact durations for Ephemeral Transcendence, Heaven's Clarity, Sword Flight, Resonant Chime, Mindlock, or Swordlight Ward beyond the stated 1-second damage-reduction duration. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
- The evidence mentions Flight Qi but provides no maximum, regeneration, or numeric consumption rate; only S5's 30% reduction is specified. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
- The evidence names Sword Dodge as a Sword Flight entry skill but does not provide a separate Sword Dodge ability description or damage/table row. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
- The exact meaning of 'additional Off-Tune Level' and the amount built by the enhanced Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning are not specified. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
- The source labels Resonance Chain effects as S1-S6 and supplies their names/effects, but does not provide separate numerical damage tables for Juque Perdition or World in Chorus. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))
- No separate standalone numeric table is supplied for Tune Break, Inherent Skills, Outro Skill, or the extra movement/state mechanics; unsupported values are therefore omitted. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605308))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Sword Sheated, Mind Unclouded**
  - To Teach, To Save, and To Sacrifice can no longer be interrupted. Qiuyuan gains 20% Crit. Rate. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524882))
- **S2: O Blade, I, Who Teach No More**
  - Bamboo's Shade additionally grants all nearby active Resonators 30% Echo Skill DMG Amplification. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524882))
- **S3: O Blade, I, Who Save No More**
  - Sundering Strike's DMG multiplier increases by 500%. When Concerto Energy is full and Qiuyuan is not in Inksplash of Mind, Resonance Skill is replaced by Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain, available once every 20s. It immediately ends Quietude Within, consumes 60 Concerto Energy, deals Aero DMG equal to 500% of Qiuyuan's ATK as Echo Skill DMG, and restores 400 Swordster's Soliloquy. The next Basic Attack becomes Inkwash Stage 3. Quietude Within cannot be gained the next time Qiuyuan enters Inksplash of Mind. To Teach, To Save, and To Sacrifice gain a 600% DMG multiplier increase and restore 30 Concerto Energy on hit. Outside Co-op, the next Outro Skill becomes Sheath Fallen, New Shoots Revealed, dealing Aero DMG equal to 500% of Qiuyuan's ATK as Echo Skill DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524882))
- **S4: O Blade, I, Who Sacrifice No More**
  - ATK increases by 20%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524882))
- **S5: O Blade, I, Who Await to be Wielded**
  - Qiuyuan ignores 15% of the target's DEF when dealing damage. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524882))
- **S6: Thus I Heard, Thus I Saw, Thus I Spoke**
  - To Sacrifice stagnates nearby targets for 5s, until they are damaged, or until Qiuyuan is switched out; unavailable in Co-op. While active, exiting Inksplash of Mind deals Aero DMG equal to 600% of Qiuyuan's ATK to all targets within range as Echo Skill DMG. Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain increases Qiuyuan's Crit. DMG by 100% for 6s; switching out ends this effect early. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/524882))

#### Resonance Liberation: Party 'til Dawn!

- Rebecca enters Mk. 31 HMG mode and creates a Stagnation field for 9.5s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- Within the field, the Mk. 31 HMG automatically fires Electro attacks treated as Basic Attack DMG and accumulates Overload. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- Pressing or holding Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation at intervals after firing begins enhances HMG firepower and accelerates Overload accumulation; this enhancement can occur up to 2 times. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- The HMG auto-locks only the enemy closest to the crosshair while aiming down sights. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- Rebecca is immobile while firing, gains 50% DMG Reduction, and is immune to interruption. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- Overload has a maximum of 90 points. Standard, first-enhanced, and twice-enhanced HMG hits grant 2, 4, and 6 points respectively. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- When HMG mode ends or Overload reaches its maximum, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast and ends HMG mode. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))
- Holding Resonance Liberation during HMG mode immediately casts BOOM! Fireworks!. Leaving HMG mode removes all Overload. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/598700))

### Roccia

- Element: Havoc; weapon: Gauntlets; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))

#### Normal Attack: Pero, Easy

- Basic Attack: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- Heavy Attack: Consumes Stamina to attack and deal Havoc DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- Heavy Attack trigger: Hitting a target with at least 100 Imagination launches Roccia into mid-air and activates Beyond Imagination. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- While charging Heavy Attack by holding the Basic Attack button, Roccia gains Imagination based on charge duration. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- During Beyond Imagination, Roccia can continue charging even after her Stamina is depleted. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- The Heavy Attack is automatically cast when the Basic Attack button is released during charging or when Imagination reaches its maximum. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina to perform a plunging attack that deals Havoc DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- Dodge Counter: Using Basic Attack immediately after a successful Dodge attacks the target and deals Havoc DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))
- Attribute bonuses: Crit. DMG increases by 2.40% and then by 5.60%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486246))

### Shorekeeper

- Element: Spectro; weapon: Rectifier; rarity: 5-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

#### Normal Attack: Origin Calculus

- Basic Attack: Performs up to four consecutive attacks that deal Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Each Basic Attack hit generates 1 Collapsed Core. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Heavy Attack: Hold the Normal Attack button to enter Unbound Form. Unbound Form continuously consumes Stamina. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- While in Unbound Form, Shorekeeper generates 1 segment of Deductive Data every second and automatically collects nearby plant collectibles. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Using all Stamina or performing an action such as casting Basic Attack ends Unbound Form and deals Spectro DMG to the target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Each accumulated segment of Deductive Data converts into 1 segment of Empirical Data and generates 1 Collapsed Core when Unbound Form ends. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Mid-air Attack: Consumes Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack. Each hit generates 1 Collapsed Core. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Quickly pressing the Normal Attack button after a Plunging Attack performs Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Dodge Counter: Pressing the Normal Attack button after a successful Dodge attacks the target and deals Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

#### Forte Circuit: Astral Chord

- Flare Star Butterfly: Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a Collapsed Core. The Collapsed Core transforms into a Flare Star Butterfly after 6s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Flare Star Butterflies automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- If 5 Collapsed Cores already exist, Shorekeeper's next Normal Attack hit instantly converts a Collapsed Core into a Flare Star Butterfly. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Illation: Requires 5 segments of Empirical Data. Casting Heavy Attack consumes all 5 segments, pulls in nearby targets, and deals Spectro DMG. All Collapsed Cores generated by this action instantly become Flare Star Butterflies. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Transmutation: Requires 5 segments of Empirical Data. Casting Mid-air Attack consumes all 5 segments and deals Spectro DMG. All Collapsed Cores generated by this action instantly become Flare Star Butterflies. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Quickly pressing the Normal Attack button after Transmutation performs Basic Attack Stage 2. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Empirical Data has a maximum capacity of 5 segments. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Basic Attack Stage 1, Stage 2, or Stage 4 hitting a target grants 1 Empirical Data segment. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Basic Attack Stage 3 hitting a target grants 2 Empirical Data segments. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- A Mid-air Attack hitting a target grants 1 Empirical Data segment. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- A Dodge Counter hitting a target grants 1 Empirical Data segment. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

#### Inherent Skill 1: Life Entwined

- When a Resonator other than Shorekeeper would take a fatal blow, that Resonator is not knocked out. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- Instead, the affected Resonator is healed for 50% of Shorekeeper's HP, while Shorekeeper loses the same amount of HP. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- This effect cannot reduce Shorekeeper's HP below 1. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- The effect can trigger once every 10 minutes. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

- Supernal Stellarealm retains all Inner Stellarealm effects. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

#### Intro Skill: Proof of Existence

- Enlightenment: Shorekeeper appears, restores HP for all nearby party members, and summons 5 Dim Star Butterflies that automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

#### Resonance Chain

- **S1: Unspoken Conjecture**
  - Stellarealms generated by Resonance Liberation: End Loop have their healing and buff effective range extended by 150%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
  - The duration of these Stellarealms is extended by 10s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
  - Casting Intro Skill Discernment no longer ends the existing Stellarealm. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))
- **S2: Night's Gift and Refusal**
  - The Outer Stellarealm increases all party members' ATK by 40%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463667))

- Floral Epistle has a maximum of 600 points. #### Outro Skill: Rippling Waters

- Grants team Resonators 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- Exits Drizzle Stance, consumes all Floral Epistle, and applies effects based on the amount consumed. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- At 0 Floral Epistle: grants all nearby team Resonators Reflecting Shadows for 6s; Reflecting Shadows increases resistance to interruption. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- At least 200 Floral Epistle: if Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui can perform the first Plume Step within the applicable timing during Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- At least 400 Floral Epistle: during Roaming Transcendent, the active Resonator inside Ceaseless Landscape deals increased DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen above 200%, this increases DMG by 0.2%, up to 12%. If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui can perform a second Plume Step within the applicable timing. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- At least 600 Floral Epistle: when Suisui performs the first Plume Step, nearby active team Resonators inside Ceaseless Landscape gain the following for the duration of Roaming Transcendent: when they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When a Resonator with Undulating Mist consumes Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain ATK; for every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen above 200%, ATK increases by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts 14s or until that Resonator switches off-field; removing it also removes the ATK increase. If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui can perform a third Plume Step within the applicable timing. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- Roaming Transcendent lasts 30s. During it, Suisui merges with Ceaseless Landscape and performs Transcendent Dance, with Plume Steps occurring at intervals based on Floral Epistle consumed. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- If Suisui becomes the active Resonator, she stops Transcendent Dance. If Ceaseless Landscape is no longer active, she exits Roaming Transcendent. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))
- Each Plume Step grants nearby team Resonators Reflecting Shadows for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within Ceaseless Landscape, and heals nearby active team Resonators within Ceaseless Landscape. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605302))

#### Forte Circuit: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices

- Sword Stance Flow - Azure: When Melody is depleted in Feather Sword Stance, Feather's Edge is replaced by this skill. It deals Havoc Heavy Attack DMG, restores 100 Melody and 1 Azure Plume, and consumes 1 Havoc Bane stack from each target hit. The Feather Sword Stance Basic Attack cycle is not reset for a short time. If the cycle resets, a Wraith of Sound completes the current attack with a fixed Havoc instance classified as Basic Attack DMG; it is unaffected by DMG Bonus effects and does not apply Havoc Bane. A successful Dodge can be triggered during the action and consumes 50 Melody. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Sword Stance Flow - Feather: When Melody is depleted in Azure Sword Stance, Feather's Edge is replaced by this skill. It switches to Feather Sword Stance, deals Havoc Heavy Attack DMG, restores 100 Melody and 1 Azure Plume, and consumes 1 Havoc Bane stack from each target hit. The Feather Sword Stance Basic Attack cycle is not reset for a short time. If the cycle resets, a Wraith of Sound completes the current attack with a fixed Havoc instance classified as Basic Attack DMG; it is unaffected by DMG Bonus effects and does not apply Havoc Bane. A successful Dodge can be triggered during the action and consumes 50 Melody. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance: At maximum Azure Plume in Azure Sword Stance, holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and all Azure Plume to create a large cyclone dealing Havoc Heavy Attack DMG. It applies 2 Havoc Bane stacks. When cast, Bated Breath is gained if Yangyang is active; this increases the attack's Crit. DMG by 160%. Bated Breath is removed when the attack ends and can be gained once every 25s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance: At maximum Azure Plume in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang is grounded and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and performs Havoc DMG. On hitting a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast. Casting Sword Stance Flow - Feather grants Streaming Storm for 15s. While Yangyang is active, the next Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom gains 160% Crit. DMG. Streaming Storm is removed when Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or its Dodge Counter Stage 3 ends. The source names the once-per-25s effect as Streaming Storm in this section, although it also refers to Drifting Mist. This attack applies 2 Havoc Bane stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall: At maximum Azure Plume in Feather Sword Stance while airborne, this replaces Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance. Switching to another Resonator automatically casts it. Pressing or holding Normal Attack consumes Stamina and all Azure Plume to deal Havoc DMG, then enters Hark the Wind for 12s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Hark the Wind: While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance becomes Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. It consumes Stamina and performs up to 3 Heavy Attack-class Havoc stages. Stages 2 and 3 can be used in mid-air near the ground. Stage 3 ends the cycle, and the cycle cannot be reset. A Dodge Counter counts toward the cycle. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Feathered Oath: When a nearby team Resonator applies Havoc Bane, Yangyang gains 1 stack for 4s, once per second, up to 6 stacks. While Yangyang is active, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Refrain: Before Azure Basic Attack Stage 4, Feather Basic Attack Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure, or Heavy Attack - Feather hits, the highest Havoc Bane stack count among targets in range is recorded and propagated to all targets in range. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Melody: Maximum 100 points. Sword Stance Flow - Azure and Sword Stance Flow - Feather restore 100 Melody. Resonance Liberation consumes all Melody. Normal Attacks consume Melody when they deal damage. Dodge windows during Sword Stance Switch - Azure, Sword Stance Switch - Feather, Sword Stance Flow - Azure, and Sword Stance Flow - Feather consume 50 Melody. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- Azure Plume: Maximum 2 points. Sword Stance Flow - Azure, Sword Stance Flow - Feather, and Intro Skill - Skybound Feather each restore 1 point. Resonance Liberation restores 1 point. Heavy Attack - Azure and Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consume all Azure Plume. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))

#### Inherent Skill 1: Unbroken Vow

- Against a target with 1–3 Havoc Bane stacks, each stack amplifies Yangyang's DMG by 10%, up to 30%. Against a target with 4–6 stacks, each stack amplifies her DMG by 12%, up to 36%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))

#### Inherent Skill 2: One Life, One Blade

- Resonance Liberation raises Havoc Bane stacks on targets hit to the maximum. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- When a nearby team Resonator inflicts Havoc Bane, Yangyang gains 1 Windbound stack, once per second, up to 6 stacks. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- At 6 Windbound stacks, all Windbound is removed and Yangyang gains One with the Wind. Windbound cannot be gained during this state. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))
- While One with the Wind lasts, casting Sword Stance Flow - Azure or Sword Stance Flow - Feather summons Feather Release: Xuanling, which attacks the target and applies 6 Havoc Bane stacks. Summoning it removes One with the Wind. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/605297))

#### Forte Circuit: Chameleon Cipher

- When Judgment Points are full, Heavy Attack is replaced by Chameleon Cipher. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/454218))

### Youhu

- Element: Glacio; weapon: Gauntlet; rarity: 4-star. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))

#### Normal Attack: Frosty Punches

- Basic Attack performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- When Frost is full, hold Basic Attack to use Heavy Attack: Frostfall. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- While in Fortune Rolling, if Frost is full, release Basic Attack to cast Frostfall. If Frostfall cannot currently be cast, Youhu performs Lucky Draw once instead. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- When Frost is not full, hold Basic Attack to enter Fortune Rolling and restore Frost over time. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Youhu also gains Frost when Basic Attacks hit a target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Frostfall makes Youhu dash forward, deal Glacio DMG, and perform Lucky Draw once. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Mid-air Attack performs a plunging attack at the cost of Stamina and deals Glacio DMG. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- If Youhu has no Antique, pressing Basic Attack immediately after a successful Dodge performs a forward thrust, deals Glacio DMG, and performs Lucky Draw once. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- The source provides Crit. Rate attribute bonuses of 1.20% and 2.80%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))

#### Resonance Skill: Scroll Divination

- Antique Appraisal:Ding: rams with a Ding, dealing Glacio DMG and effectively breaking enemy stance. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Antique Appraisal:Mask: throws a Mask at enemies in front and can pull enemies along its path. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))

#### Forte Circuit: Poetic Essence

- At four Auspices, hold Basic Attack to release Poetic Essence, dealing Glacio DMG classified as Resonance Skill DMG and restoring HP for all nearby party members. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Youhu can hold up to four Auspices. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Poetic Essence deals Glacio DMG to enemies within its range, then applies an effect based on the Auspice combination. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Free Verse: four different types of Auspice; additionally reduces the Vibration Strength of enemies hit. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Antithesis: one pair of Auspices; increases Poetic Essence DMG by 70%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Double Pun: two pairs of Auspices; additionally restores HP for all nearby party members. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Triplet: three identical Auspices; increases Poetic Essence DMG by 175%. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Perfect Rhyme: four identical Auspices; activates Free Verse, Double Pun, and Triplet simultaneously. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Casting Poetic Essence removes all Auspices. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Youhu gains an Auspice through Antique Appraisal; using Basic Attack while holding an Antique grants the corresponding Auspice. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- Antiques can be unlocked by Resonance Skill Scroll Divination, Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders, Heavy Attack Frostfall, Resonance Liberation Fortune's Favor, or Dodge Counter. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))
- The source provides a Concerto Regen value of 20. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/463668))

#### Evidence limitations

- The evidence does not provide exact Redundant Energy gained from Normal Attack hits or the listed skill casts, nor the exact Blaze recovered by the final stage of Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- The source uses both “Heavy Slash - Lightsmash” and the apparent typo “Heavy Slash - Lighstmash”; they are treated as the same named attack. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- The detailed formulas for several attacks are presented as additive percentage strings without explaining hit segmentation or multiplier interpretation. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- The source does not specify a numerical Redundant Energy cost for Crisis Response Protocol beyond consuming all available energy. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- The source does not specify the exact duration of Standard Defense Protocol, Crisis Response Protocol, or Scorching Light Ready Stances. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- No healing or shield effect is stated in the supplied evidence; the defensive effects are damage reduction, damage negation for the triggering hit, interruption immunity, and Stagnation. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- The source mentions Inferno Mode increasing the Basic Attack DMG multiplier and lists a 25% increase, but does not clarify whether the value applies to every Basic Attack variant. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- The target scope of some Stagnation and Vibration Strength effects is described as the target or nearby targets, but the evidence does not provide ranges or durations for those effects. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))
- No separate skill-detail table is supplied for Tune Break. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/486248))

#### Forte Circuit: Ink and Wash

- Heavy Attack - Conjuration consumes Stamina and deals Glacio DMG. It can be performed by briefly holding Basic Attack after Basic Attack 3, pressing Basic Attack shortly after Manifestation, holding Basic Attack shortly after Stroke of Genius or Creation's Zenith, holding Basic Attack while airborne, or holding Basic Attack after a successful Dodge. - When a Phantasmic Imprint is nearby and Painter's Delight has 2 stacks, Stroke of Genius is replaced by Creation's Zenith, which can be cast in mid-air. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))
- Creation's Zenith removes all Painter's Delight stacks, moves Zhezhi to and removes the selected Phantasmic Imprint, and summons an Ivory Herald to attack the target. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))
- Creation's Zenith deals greater Glacio DMG classified as Basic Attack DMG and increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 18% for 27s. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))
- If the selected Imprint is in mid-air, Creation's Zenith refreshes the mid-air Dodge Counter. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))
- Afflatus has a maximum of 90 points and is gained from Normal Attacks and the Intro Skill. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))

- Tune Break has no damage, cost, cooldown, or regeneration values in the fetched evidence. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))
- No separate skill table is supplied for Calligrapher's Touch, Flourish, or Carve and Draw; their listed numerical values are taken directly from the effect text where available. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))
- The source's Resonance Chain heading includes a recommendation section, but only the six explicit S1-S6 node descriptions were used. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/461497))


---

## Data Quality & Coverage

Snapshot: 2026-09-20. This is a secondary-source, source-linked research corpus, not an official Kuro game-data export and not a live in-game test.

### Coverage manifest

| Dataset | Included | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| Echo mainstats | 88 cost/rarity/stat rows | +0 and maximum values from two sources, with conflicts preserved |
| Echo substats | 13 types | Discrete rolls, not official drop probabilities |
| Sonata sets | 34 | All collected nonempty set-effect rows |
| Echo skills | 181 | 43 Cost 4; 53 Cost 3; 85 Cost 1 |
| Weapons | 122 | Named passive mechanics and R1–R5 parameters; two secondary-only refinements flagged |
| Character kits | 58 | Variants counted separately; 348 chain nodes |
| Supplementary Echo pages | 23 | Missing data checked against a second source |

Counts are generated from the included normalized records, not inferred from a site's headline count. The inventory follows the fetched [Echo list](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452491), [weapon list](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452490), [Sonata list](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456215) and the per-character/per-item pages linked in the datasets.

### Inclusion and exclusion

- The source pages show a 3.6-era database with 3.7 previews; this pack does not certify every entry's exact live-release status on every region/server. See [Game8 version overview](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/559680).
- Five Echo rows with TBD identifiers/skills were excluded: Formrender, Skywatch Lancer, Soulfrayer, Bloomburst Puppet and Jade Nether Serpent. They are not silently treated as completed entries. ([Game8 Echo List](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/452491))
- The term “all” in filenames means all records in the researched inventory, not a guarantee of exhaustive future or hidden content. Character variants are separate kit records; aliases are not extra characters.
- Values are factual paraphrases of fetched pages. Full raw editorial articles, lore, images, builds and copyrighted page dumps are not bundled.

### Resolved or explicitly preserved conflicts

- **Mainstats:** 39 cost/rarity/stat rows have differing or missing endpoints between Game8 and Wiki. Both readings are included; `null` marks an unresolved numeric endpoint in JSON. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/456278); [Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))
- **Reroll rule:** Older stats pages say substats cannot change; the current Transducer guide gives a reroll workflow. The pack follows the newer, specific Transducer guide rather than repeating the old absolute claim. ([Game8 Transducer](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/578127); [Wiki](https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Echo/Stats))
- **Tyro / Training:** Passive values were replaced with individually fetched Game8 R1–R5 tables. Tyro starts at 5% ATK; Training starts at 4%, not the lower values encountered elsewhere. ([Tyro Broadblade](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455942); [Training Broadblade](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455941))
- **Abyss Surges:** R1 Energy Regen is recorded as 12.8%, consistent between Game8 and Wuthering.gg; a conflicting WuWaBuild value is not used. ([Game8](https://game8.co/games/Wuthering-Waves/archives/455915); [Wuthering.gg](https://wuthering.gg/weapons/abyss-surges))
- **Lumingloss / Thunderbolt:** Game8 lacks R2–R5. Theria Games supplies the progression, which is marked secondary-only and should be checked in game before precise optimization. ([Lumingloss](https://theriagames.com/guide/wuthering-waves-lumingloss/); [Thunderbolt](https://theriagames.com/guide/wuthering-waves-thunderbolt/))
- **Jiyan:** Prydwen corrects the Normal Attack trigger wording for Abyssal Slash / Banner of Triumph; numeric Lv.1 rows remain attributed to Game8. ([Prydwen](https://www.prydwen.gg/wuthering-waves/characters/jiyan))
- **Echo rank versus rarity:** Supplementary pages sometimes show inconsistent rank labels. Their coefficients are kept in a separate evidence block instead of being silently combined with the main rarity-5 block. ([Dreamless](https://wuthering.gg/echos/dreamless))

### Character limitations by record

These are source omissions or ambiguities, not necessarily missing gameplay mechanics. A mechanic having no duration in its source does not prove that it has no duration.
